title: Telesales Representative (Virtual Assistant)
description:
Position Overview



We are looking for a confident, persuasive, and target-driven Telesales Associate who can turn prospects into qualified sales opportunities. This role requires more than making calls, you must capture attention, build trust quickly, identify buying signals, overcome initial objections, and successfully transfer interested prospects to a designated sales specialist.



The ideal candidate has strong spoken English, a sales-oriented mindset, and the ability to influence conversations naturally while maintaining professionalism. We are looking for individuals who are motivated by targets, coachable, resilient, and focused on generating quality leads that contribute directly to revenue.



Key Responsibilities

-Make high-volume inbound and outbound calls to prospective customers using company-provided systems and lead lists.

-Deliver a compelling opening that captures attention and establishes credibility within the first few seconds.

-Build rapport quickly and engage prospects in meaningful, sales-focused conversations.

-Ask strategic qualifying questions to identify customer needs, interest, buying intent, and readiness to purchase.

-Present the value of the product or service using approved sales scripts, key benefits, and accurate information.

-Handle initial objections confidently, maintain engagement, and create interest without being aggressive or misleading.

-Identify qualified prospects and execute smooth, consent-based live transfers to the designated sales specialist.

-Maximize successful transfers by ensuring prospects understand the purpose and value of speaking with the sales representative.

-Record call outcomes, qualification details, objections, and transfer results accurately in the designated system.

-Meet or exceed assigned KPIs for call volume, qualified leads, successful transfers, conversion quality, and attendance.

-Apply coaching and feedback to improve sales conversations, qualification rates, and overall performance.

-Follow approved scripts, customer communication standards, and applicable calling and consent requirements.



Qualifications

-Strong spoken English, clear pronunciation, confident delivery, and the ability to communicate persuasively.

-Previous experience in outbound sales, cold calling, telemarketing, lead generation, appointment setting, or call center sales is an advantage.

-Demonstrated ability to engage prospects, ask effective qualifying questions, handle objections, and influence customer decisions.

-Comfortable initiating conversations with strangers and handling rejection without losing confidence or momentum.

-Able to identify buying signals and distinguish genuinely interested prospects from unqualified leads.

-Sales-driven, competitive, self-motivated, and focused on achieving measurable results.

-Coachable and willing to apply feedback, follow structured sales processes, and improve through call reviews.

-Strong listening skills, attention to detail, and accurate documentation habits.

-Reliable attendance, accountability, and the ability to perform consistently throughout the shift.



Work Requirements

-Comfortable making consistent, high-volume outbound calls throughout the shift.

-Willing to work toward daily and weekly performance targets and be evaluated based on measurable KPIs.

-Able to follow a structured sales and qualification process while keeping conversations natural and engaging.

-Must maintain a stable internet connection, reliable computer, and good-quality headset.

-Must be available for the required work schedule, including applicable night shifts, weekends, and other agreed working hours.

-Must be open to regular coaching, call monitoring, and performance reviews.



What Success Looks Like



Success in this role is measured by your ability to generate qualified opportunities, secure successful live transfers, maintain high call quality, and consistently meet performance targets. We value agents who combine strong communication skills with commercial awareness, resilience, and a genuine drive to produce results.

title: Marketing Executive – UK - Remote
description:
About the role

We are looking for a practical, creative Marketing Specialist to manage marketing activity across BearTOOLS and Bear Safety.

BearTOOLS provides workplace safety products and accessories, while Bear Safety focuses on automated industrial safety solutions. This role combines digital marketing, content creation and graphic design with website management, Amazon product launches and product development support.

You will take work from the initial brief through to delivery and performance review, working closely with sales, leadership, suppliers, freelancers and external partners. The role suits someone who enjoys varied work, can organise their priorities independently and is comfortable moving between creative tasks and data analysis.

Key responsibilities

Marketing planning and campaign management

• Plan and maintain a marketing calendar across both brands.

• Coordinate campaigns around product launches, events and sales priorities.

• Create and manage HubSpot
 campaigns, including copy, design, audience segments, scheduling and reporting.

• Set up, monitor and optimise Google Ads campaigns within agreed budgets.

• Review results and recommend improvements that support enquiries, sales and business growth.

Social media and content

• Plan, create and schedule content for LinkedIn,
, Instagram and TikTok.

• Write captions, blogs, website copy, product descriptions and other marketing content.

• Create graphics, carousels and short videos suited to each platform.

• Apply basic SEO principles and coordinate specialist work with freelancers.

• Maintain a consistent brand voice and accurate product information across channels.

Website management and reporting

• Publish and update blogs, product information and other website content using Webflow CMS and Shopify.

• Check page formatting, images, links and mobile layouts.

• Use Google Analytics and Google Search Console to review traffic, engagement and search performance.

• Report against agreed KPIs and identify practical opportunities for improvement.

• Participate in weekly sales and marketing meetings and quarterly reviews, preparing updates and presentations.

Graphic design and creative production

• Create original graphics for campaigns, sales materials and requests from the team.

• Develop catalogues and brochures from scratch, including structure, copywriting, page layout and final artwork.

• Design presentations for sales, events and internal meetings.

• Create product packaging, labels, datasheets and supporting artwork.

• Edit product photographs and videos for websites, social media and Amazon.

• Prepare production-ready files and maintain organised source files and approved versions.

Bear Safety artwork and event support

• Create bespoke projection and signage artwork.

• Produce projection mock-ups on customer photographs to illustrate proposed solutions.

• Use SketchUp to develop event stand layouts and visual mock-ups.

• Prepare exhibition graphics, invitations, presentations and promotional materials.

• Coordinate artwork requirements and deadlines with colleagues and suppliers.

Product development support

• Communicate with suppliers about product specifications, branding, packaging and samples.

• Request quotations, minimum order quantities and lead times.

• Coordinate sample feedback and document agreed changes.

• Prepare product specifications, datasheets, packaging and label artwork.

• Keep product information consistent across supplier documents, sales materials and marketing content.

Amazon product launches and listing management

• Research competitors, pricing, product features and positioning using Amazon and Jungle Scout.

• Write listing titles, bullet points and descriptions.

• Create listing images and A+ content.

• Upload assets and update content through Amazon Seller Central.

• Check listings for errors, missing content and opportunities for improvement.

• Set up promotions using agreed products, dates and discounts.

title: Video Editor & Content Researcher – True Crime / Police Bodycam Documentary YouTube Channel
description:
JOB TITLE: Video Editor & Content Researcher – True Crime / Police Bodycam Documentary YouTube Channel



About the Role

I’m launching a true-crime YouTube channel that turns police bodycam footage into cinematic, Netflix-style documentaries. I need a reliable, self-driven virtual assistant to help build the channel from research through to publishing. This is an ongoing role, with room to grow into a team lead as the channel scales.



Key Responsibilities



Footage Sourcing & Research

Find compelling, high-quality police bodycam and related footage that has not been widely covered on YouTube.

Verify where each clip comes from (public records releases, police department or court channels, public-domain or properly licensed sources).

Keep a tracker (Google Sheet) of sourced cases, links, licensing/usage status, and case details.

Case Research & Scriptwriting

Research each case: timeline, background, outcome, court records, and legal context.

Write binge-worthy narration scripts with strong hooks, pacing, and cliffhangers, plus educational segments (legal rights, police procedure, de-escalation, the justice process).

Video Editing

Edit raw footage into a polished, documentary-style video: voice-over, music, sound design, captions, graphics, maps, timelines, and on-screen explainers.

Use blur and censoring where needed to follow YouTube’s guidelines on graphic content.

Deliver consistent, high-quality videos on an agreed schedule.

Channel Management & Growth

Create thumbnails, titles, descriptions, tags, and chapters optimized for search and click-through.

Upload and schedule videos; set up end screens, cards, and playlists.

Track analytics (CTR, retention, watch time) and report what’s working.

Competitor & Niche Analysis

Study successful true-crime and bodycam channels, including Dr Insanity, to understand their format, pacing, narrative structure, and posting schedule.

Recommend ways to improve on what they do and to give our channel its own identity, voice, and branding.

Monetization Support

Help the channel meet YouTube Partner Program requirements and keep it compliant with copyright, community guideline, and advertiser-friendly policies.

Help explore additional revenue streams (sponsorships, affiliate links, merchandise, memberships).



Requirements



Proven video editing experience (Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut, or CapCut Pro), with a portfolio or samples

Strong English writing and comprehension; voice-over skills are a plus

Experience with YouTube SEO, thumbnails, and analytics

Understanding of YouTube’s copyright, fair use, and monetization policies

Strong research skills and attention to detail

Comfortable with sensitive and sometimes disturbing content

Reliable internet, a capable computer, and the ability to meet deadlines independently

Good communication in English (Slack, Google Meet, or similar)



Nice to Have



Previous true-crime or documentary-style channel experience

Motion graphics skills (After Effects)

Experience managing or growing a YouTube channel



Work Details



Full-time or part-time (state your availability)

Remote, with flexible hours but firm delivery deadlines

Long-term opportunity for the right person



Compensation

Negotiable based on experience, quality of work, and output. Please include your expected rate in your application.



To Apply, Please Send:



Your resume or profile link

2–3 video editing samples (documentary, commentary, or true-crime style preferred)

A short note on how you would find and verify original bodycam footage

Your expected rate and weekly availability

A brief answer: Pick one true-crime YouTube channel (recommended Dr Insanity) and tell me what they do well and what you would improve.

title: Podcast Trailer Storyteller / Trailer Editor (Health & Wellness Podcasts)
description:
37 Projects is a podcast and YouTube production agency. We work with doctors and health experts from the US, UK and Australia. Every full podcast episode we produce opens with a trailer.



We need a storyteller who can watch a 1-hour conversation and find the 60 to 90 seconds that make people stay.



What you will do:

- Go through full podcast transcripts and pick the moments for the trailer

- Build the trailer as ONE connected story: a hook, a moment of value, tension, and a cliffhanger. Not random strong quotes stitched together

- Trim the moments so every second earns its place

- Guide our video editors: what to cut, what order, where the pacing drops

- Edit the trailer yourself, if you also edit (optional)

- Use AI tools to work faster, while your eye makes the final call



You are a fit if:

- You can explain WHY a trailer works, not only that it works

- You have watched Diary of a CEO trailers and understand why people click

- Your English is strong. You will read long conversations every day

- You can give clear, direct feedback to editors



We hire for two setups: someone who picks the moments AND edits, or someone who picks the moments and guides our editors. Tell us which one you are in the form.



Salary: PHP 35,000 to 40,000 per month to start.

title: Possibly the Best Full-Time Finance Job Ever
description:
We believe beauty businesses are a force for good — and we’re looking for an experienced accountant who wants to help salon and spa owners build stronger, more profitable businesses.



True Profit Salons is a fully remote U.S.-based financial advisory company. We provide accounting, bookkeeping, financial consulting, and Profit First guidance to beauty businesses across the U.S. and Canada.



We’re hiring a full-time Accountant / CFO who will work directly with our clients as a trusted financial partner.



This is NOT just a bookkeeping position.



You’ll get to know each client, understand their business and goals, maintain accurate financials, meet with them regularly, and help them make better financial decisions.



What You’ll Do



• Maintain and review client bookkeeping

• Reconcile bank and credit card accounts

• Prepare and review financial reports

• Work extensively in QuickBooks Online

• Meet with clients regularly via Zoom

• Help clients understand their financial performance

• Advise clients on cash flow, profitability, and financial decisions

• Implement and support the Profit First system

• Identify financial problems and opportunities

• Collaborate closely with our internal finance team



What We’re Looking For



• 3+ years of bookkeeping or accounting experience

• 2+ years of QuickBooks Online experience

• Strong understanding of accounting and financial reporting

• Excellent spoken and written English

• Comfortable leading conversations with U.S.-based clients

• Confident communicating through Zoom,
, and messaging platforms

• Self-motivated and able to work independently

• Extremely organized and dependable

• High level of integrity and professionalism

• Someone who genuinely enjoys helping business owners succeed



Experience in financial advisory, consulting, Profit First, or working directly with small-business owners is a major plus.



English Communication



This is a highly client-facing role.



You must be fluent and confident communicating in English, both verbally and in writing. You’ll regularly lead Zoom meetings with U.S. business owners, explain financial information, ask thoughtful questions, and provide recommendations.



We’re looking for someone who can communicate naturally and build strong relationships with clients — not simply someone with technical accounting knowledge.



Schedule



This position is fully remote and offers flexibility, but because we primarily serve U.S.-based clients, you must be available for at least 3–4 hours during U.S. business hours (9 AM–5 PM Eastern Time).



You’ll also need to attend scheduled client and team meetings.



The remainder of your working hours can be structured more flexibly.



Compensation & Growth



During your first 2–3 months of onboarding and training, compensation is $1,000 USD per month.



After onboarding, compensation becomes milestone-based, with client capacity and responsibility being major factors.



As your skills, efficiency, and responsibilities grow, your earning potential can grow significantly.



We’ll also train you to become a Certified Profit First Professional.



Our company is growing quickly, and we’re especially interested in someone who wants to grow with us. For the right person, there is significant potential for increased responsibility, leadership opportunities, and higher compensation.



Why You Might Love Working With Us



• 100% remote

• Flexible working structure

• Meaningful work with real business owners

• Direct client relationships

• Significant learning and professional development

• Profit First certification

• Strong long-term growth potential

• Opportunity to grow into leadership



If you love accounting but also enjoy people, strategy, problem-solving, and seeing the real-world impact of your work, we’d love to hear from you.



Interested? Apply directly and include:

- A brief note explaining why this opportunity interests you

- Why you think you’d be a great fit for True Profit Salons

- A link to a 1-minute video introduction telling us a little about yourself and why you’re interested in the role

title: Work From Home Production Coordinator (Apparel / Fashion) | 5:30am to 2pm PHT, Mon to Fri
description:
**Work from home, early shift, weekends off. Apparel or garment production experience is a must.**



Love fashion and know your way around a garment factory? An established Australian fashion and apparel group (denim and apparel brands sold in Australia and internationally) is looking for a full-time Production Coordinator to join its production team, 100% from home. You will work closely with our Australian team and
 our garment factories every day, so you need to understand how a garment gets from tech pack to warehouse.



## Why you'll love it

- **100% work from home.** No commute, no traffic, no relocating.

- **Early day shift, no graveyard.** 8:30am to 5pm Melbourne time, which is 5:30am to 2pm Philippine time (6:30am to 3pm from April). You finish by mid-afternoon with the rest of the day for family.

- **Weekends and Australian public holidays off.** Monday to Friday only.

- **Long-term, full-time role** with a stable, growing Australian fashion group, not a short project.

- **Paid in USD:** US$300 per week.

- **Proper training** from our Senior Production Manager, with recorded videos to refer back to.

- **Real team culture.** You'll be part of the team on daily calls, not just a task-taker.

- **Grow your fashion career** working with international brands, factories and products you can see in stores.



## About the role

This is a detail-heavy admin role inside a fashion production team. You will look after the paperwork side of the purchase order lifecycle, from raising the PO and sending it to the factory through to delivery into our warehouse, plus a busy daily supplier inbox (30 to 40
s most mornings). Accuracy matters more than speed: your data feeds supplier orders, delivery schedules, finance and sales.



## Must haves

- 2+ years in apparel or garment production, merchandising or sourcing coordination, working directly with factories or suppliers

- Solid understanding of the garment product lifecycle: tech packs, sampling (proto, fit, PP/sealer samples), costing and FOB, purchase orders, critical path and WIP tracking, QC/inspections, ex-factory dates and shipping bookings

- Strong Microsoft Excel, including: pivot tables (filter by season, total units at Supplier and PO level, tabular layout); VLOOKUP to pull FOB costs from another sheet (XLOOKUP is also fine); filters; intermediate formulas including SUBTOTAL on units, a volume-based FOB discount (a percentage off when units are above a threshold, otherwise no discount), and units × final FOB; conditional formatting to highlight high unit quantities; and date formulas to calculate the bulk handover date from the PO raise plus fabric and garment lead times, then the ETA by adding shipping days. Experience building and maintaining WIP or delivery trackers with high-volume data.

- You will complete a test on these tasks.

- Fashion industry experience is essential: you understand seasonal calendars (how drops, intakes and delivery windows run by season), core product lines (continuity styles that repeat season to season), and recuts (repeat production runs of strong sellers).

- Clear, professional written English for daily factory
s, plus confidence on phone and video calls

- Experience raising and amending POs in an ERP or purchasing system

- Highly organised, works to deadlines across time zones, flags delays early, asks rather than assumes

- Own computer with Microsoft Excel installed (desktop version), reliable internet and a backup connection, quiet workspace with webcam



## Nice to haves

- PLM or ERP experience (WFX, CIN7, NetSuite, SAP, Centric or similar)

- Experience with Australian, US or European fashion brands or buyers

- Denim experience

- Knowledge of compliance documents (scope certificates, fibre certification, audits/CAPs)

- Basic understanding of shipping and logistics



## What you will do

- Raise bulk, small-run and recut purchase orders accurately against approved planning files

- Upload FOB, freight, duty and other costs, applying negotiated discounts and surcharges correctly

- Action PO amendments (cancellations, additions, colour and quantity changes) and keep system data aligned

- Maintain delivery schedules and trackers through to arrival, updating ex-factory changes and delays

- Manage the daily factory inbox: barcode requests, order queries, sample quality feedback and late delivery follow-ups

- Report factory updates and slipping dates to the production managers early and concisely

- Chase and file compliance documents and log them in the relevant portals

- Maintain recut trackers so the sales team has live visibility

- Run data checks across the ERP, planning files and schedules and flag discrepancies

- Prepare recurring reports and inputs for margin, on-time delivery and factory performance



## The team

The team is friendly, high energy and wants you to feel part of it, just working from a different city.



## How to apply

**Start your application subject with: APPAREL**



Attach your CV and answer these questions in your application (short answers are fine, but they must be your own words):



1. Briefly list the apparel or garment brands, factories or suppliers you have coordinated with, your role, and the years.

2. Describe the sample stages a style goes through from first proto to bulk production approval. What is checked at each stage?

3. What information is normally included in a tech pack?

4. Tell us about a time a factory was running late on a delivery. What did you do, who did you tell, and what was the result?

5. Which Excel functions do you use most often for tracking POs or WIP? Rate your Excel from 1 to 10.

6. Which ERP or PLM systems have you used?

7. Can you work 5:30am to 2pm PHT, Monday to Friday, on camera? Do you have your own computer with Microsoft Excel installed?



Applications without the subject code or without apparel/garment experience will not be considered.

title: Medical Practice Operations Manager / VA – UK Healthcare
description:
Medical Practice Operations Manager / Virtual Assistant – UK Healthcare



Salary: £400–£600 per month

Hours: Approximately 20–25 hours per week

Schedule: Monday–Friday, UK business hours

Location: Remote – Philippines

Start Date: 1 December 2026

Position: Long-term, part-time



About the Role



We are an established private healthcare clinic in the United Kingdom looking for an experienced, highly organised and proactive Medical Practice Operations Manager / Virtual Assistant.



This is a long-term position for someone with previous experience in healthcare practice administration, medical billing and financial administration.



We are not looking for a general virtual assistant who simply completes tasks when instructed.



We are looking for someone who can take full operational ownership of our clinic’s administration, financial processes and diary management, ensuring the business runs efficiently and that important tasks are completed without constant supervision.



You will work directly with the clinic owner and become the main administrative point of contact for the business.



Key Responsibilities



1. Financial Management, Medical Billing & Reconciliation



You will take responsibility for the clinic’s day-to-day financial administration.



Responsibilities include:



* Managing invoicing and billing through Cliniko.

* Processing and submitting medical insurance claims.

* Managing UK private health insurance portals.

* Monitoring outstanding invoices and unpaid claims.

* Investigating rejected insurance claims and arranging corrections or resubmissions.

* Reconciling insurer remittances against invoices.

* Reconciling bank receipts against payments recorded in Cliniko.

* Managing bookkeeping processes within Xero.

* Monitoring debtors and following up overdue payments.

* Maintaining accurate records of income, payments and outstanding balances.

* Preparing weekly and monthly financial administration reports.

* Liaising with the clinic owner and external accountant when required.



The expectation is that you will take ownership of these processes from beginning to end, rather than simply assisting with individual tasks.



Financial approval, authorisation of payments and final accounting decisions will remain with the clinic owner and accountant.



2. Complete Diary & Appointment Management



You will take responsibility for maintaining and managing the clinic’s appointment diaries.



This includes:



* Managing bookings, cancellations and rescheduling.

* Responding promptly to new patient enquiries.

* Following up prospective patients who have not booked.

* Managing practitioner availability and appointment schedules.

* Monitoring cancellations and identifying opportunities to fill empty appointments.

* Maintaining waiting lists.

* Coordinating patient communication.

* Ensuring diaries remain organised and appointments are allocated appropriately.

* Monitoring outstanding appointment-related administrative tasks.



You will be expected to proactively manage the diaries rather than simply respond to booking requests.



3.
 & Telephone Administration



* Manage the clinic’s shared
 inbox.

* Respond professionally to patient and administrative enquiries.

* Answer and manage incoming calls using our VoIP telephone system.

* Return missed calls and follow up voi
s.

* Coordinate communication with patients, clinicians and insurance providers.

* Escalate clinical questions and other matters requiring the clinic owner’s attention.

* Maintain professional communication standards.



4. Business Administration & Practice Operations



* Take responsibility for the organisation of daily clinic administration.

* Maintain administrative records and task lists.

* Develop and improve standard operating procedures.

* Identify inefficient processes and recommend improvements.

* Ensure outstanding administrative tasks are followed through to completion.

* Maintain organised communication between the clinic owner and practitioners.

* Produce regular operational reports.

* Help establish consistent, reliable systems that allow the clinic to run efficiently.



Essential Experience



Applicants must have previous experience in healthcare practice administration AND medical billing.



We require:



* Previous experience supporting a medical, physiotherapy or allied healthcare clinic.

* Demonstrable experience managing medical billing and invoicing.

* Experience with bookkeeping, reconciliation or financial administration.

* Excellent written and spoken English.

* Strong attention to detail.

* Excellent organisational and time-management skills.

* Ability to work independently and solve problems.

* Experience using healthcare practice-management systems.

* Experience managing patient appointments and communications.

* Understanding of confidential healthcare information and UK GDPR requirements.

* Availability during UK business hours.



Applicants without relevant healthcare administration and billing experience should not apply.



Software & Systems



Experience with the following systems is highly desirable:



* Cliniko – practice management, appointments and invoicing.

* Xero – bookkeeping and financial reconciliation.

* Healthcode – UK private medical insurance billing.

* UK health insurance portals – including Bupa, AXA Health, Aviva, Vitality and other providers.

* VoIP telephone systems – patient calls, missed calls and voi
 management.

* Microsoft Outlook / Microsoft 365 –
 and office administration.

* Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets – reporting and reconciliation.



You do not need to have used every system, but you must demonstrate relevant experience and the ability to learn new software quickly.



Confidentiality & Data Protection



The position involves working with confidential patient information and financial records.



Applicants must have an understanding of healthcare confidentiality, appropriate UK GDPR practices and secure data handling.



The successful candidate will be required to follow strict confidentiality procedures and comply with the clinic’s data-protection and security requirements.



Access to systems will be provided only after the appropriate agreements, security arrangements and training have been completed.



Working Arrangements



This is a long-term, part-time remote position.



The initial workload is expected to be approximately 20–25 hours per week, depending on the successful candidate’s experience and agreed monthly fee.



Working hours must overlap with UK business hours, Monday to Friday.



The initial monthly budget is £400–£600.



There is potential for the role and remuneration to develop as the business grows.



Who We’re Looking For



We are seeking someone who is:



* Proactive rather than reactive.

* Highly organised and dependable.

* Comfortable taking responsibility.

* Confident communicating with UK patients.

* Experienced in medical billing and financial administration.

* Able to identify problems and resolve them.

* Comfortable working independently.

* Interested in becoming a long-term member of a healthcare business.



We want someone who takes pride in ensuring that a clinic’s administration, appointment diaries and financial processes are running properly.



How to Apply



Please answer the following questions in your application:



1. Healthcare Experience



Describe your previous experience working in medical, physiotherapy or healthcare practice administration.



2. Medical Billing



What experience do you have with UK medical insurance billing, invoice reconciliation, rejected claims and outstanding payments?



3. Software



Which of the following systems have you used: Cliniko, Xero, Healthcode, UK insurer portals, Outlook and VoIP telephone systems?



4. Financial Administration



Have you previously taken responsibility for managing the invoicing, reconciliation and outstanding payments of a healthcare business? Please describe your responsibilities.



5. Diary Management



Describe your experience independently managing practitioner diaries, appointment bookings and patient communications.



6. Availability



Confirm your availability during UK working hours and how many hours per week you can provide.



7. Salary



Please state your proposed monthly salary and the number of working hours included.



8. Relevant Experience



Provide an example of a healthcare administration or billing process you have personally improved.



9. English Communication



Please include a short audio introduction in English, outlining your experience and explaining why you are suitable for this position.



Applications that do not answer these questions will not be considered.



We look forward to hearing from experienced candidates interested in developing a long-term working relationship.

title: AI Image Designer (ChatGPT, OpenArt + Canva) | Premium Spiritual Wellness Brand
description:
At Anima we sell spiritual tools that create a spark: crystal sets, incense and candles that open your eyes to what is already inside you. The products are a catalyst; the person is the creator. Every Anima piece is created with one intention: to raise the consciousness and vibration of the planet. We sell on Amazon in the US, Canada, the UK, across Europe and in Australia, our own store is launching, and we are a fast-growing e-commerce company that runs on AI. Image quality is the heart of the brand.



If you are interested in spirituality, meditation and crystals, and you care about this kind of product, you will fit here better than someone who only sees a picture to make.



THE JOB



You turn briefs into finished, on-brand images with AI. Our Creative Strategist gives you the product, the angle, the message, example copy and reference photos of the real product. You generate the image with AI (ChatGPT and OpenArt today), make the product in the picture exactly the product we ship, retouch and finish it in Canva, set the copy on it, and deliver files ready to publish.



Today most of the work is Amazon listing images and A+ content. Website, ads, social, packaging and new product lines come next, and they all need the same thing from you: a finished image with the right words on it. You do not d
 what gets made or write the brief. You own the craft.



Anima runs on AI systems. Our brand rules, product facts and procedures live in a company AI you are connected to from day one, and our AI agents help you get the wording and direction of each image right before you generate. The system gives you the what; you bring the how.



You are measured on three numbers we share with you every month: on-time delivery (you set the date, you hit it, target 95%), first-pass approval (approved with one round of notes or none, target 75% within your first 60 days), and output (finished files delivered).



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



- Experience making AI images that sell. The one thing we care about most. You have produced AI imagery for e-commerce or retail brands, for products that were actually sold, not AI art because it looks beautiful. You can show three pieces and explain exactly how you made each one.

- Product and model fidelity. We make images that do not look like AI images. The product must be exactly the product we ship (shape, colour, label, logo), and any person in the frame must look real. If you cannot get the product right, nothing else matters.

- An eye for every detail. AI leaves mistakes behind: misspelled text on a label, a logo out of shape, extra fingers, a placeholder left in a document. You find and fix them before anyone else sees the file.

- AI image tools and Canva, fast in both. Every image is retouched and finished by hand: fidelity, colour, cleanup, layout, type. Photoshop is fine for parts of it; Canva is where the team works.

- Excellent written English. Not good, excellent. You write the words that go on the picture, so a headline from you reads like a native copywriter wrote it. We read your application as your first English test.

- You hold a brand. Ten images from you look like one company made them.



WHO YOU ARE



Ambitious. You work hard and you go beyond what was asked. Optimistic and joyful to work with. Smart enough to understand feedback the first time and apply it the next, not argue it. You ask questions before you start, not after you deliver, and you find your own solutions.



Strong pluses: you already know Amazon's image rules (pure white main image, A+ modules for desktop and mobile). You have lived, studied or worked outside the Philippines, worked closely with Western brands and teams, or travelled widely. Our customers are in North America, Europe and Australia, and people with that exposure fit the team faster.



PAY AND SCHEDULE



- USD 1,500 to 2,000 per month depending on experience, paid monthly. Pay is reviewed twice a year against your KPIs; consistently hitting them earns bonuses tied to those KPIs.

- Full-time, Monday to Friday, 8 hours a day. Four hours are fixed, 4:00 pm to 8:00 pm Philippine time, alongside our team in Europe and Bangkok. You organise the other four.

- Full-time independent contractor, working only for Anima (no other clients). Start as soon as possible, three-month probation. We pay for the AI tools and Canva Pro you use for our work.

- You report to our Creative Strategist.



HOW WE HIRE



1. We read every complete application and invite the strongest to a paid test.

2. A paid test from a real brief (USD 50, whatever the outcome). It is the same work as the job, and it is how we choose. You tell us when you will deliver, and we see if you hit it.

3. One 45-minute video call in English with our CEO, CMO and Creative Strategist: your test, the role, pay and start date.



HOW TO APPLY



1. Start your application with the word CITRINE.

2. Send three AI-generated product or e-commerce images you made. For at least one, put the real product photo, your prompt and the raw AI output next to the finished image, so we can see how close you got to the real product.

3. Share every link so anyone with the link can open it, without signing in or requesting access. A link we cannot open counts as missing.

4. Look at 
 (our Energy Cleansing Set). In three or four sentences, tell us which image you would redo first and why.

5. Confirm you can work 4:00 pm to 8:00 pm Philippine time on weekdays, and tell us which laptop you work on (model and year).



Applications missing any of the five will not be reviewed.

title: Freelance Social Content Video Editor
description:
Long-Term Freelance Opportunity | Remote | Short-Form Video



We’re looking for a creative, chronically online (in the best way) freelance video editor to help bring our organic social content to life.



Someone who understands internet humor, has impeccable comedic timing, and knows that sometimes a perfectly placed zoom, unnecessarily dramatic sound effect, or completely unhinged overlay can make an entire video.



We’re talking quick cuts, chaotic energy, unexpected visual gags, meme references, layered sound design, and edits that feel like they were made by someone who spends a little too much time on the internet. (But we also love a clean, simple edit when the content calls for it.)



This is a long-term freelance opportunity focused primarily on 9:16 vertical video for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.



What You’ll Do:

> Transform raw footage into entertaining, scroll-stopping short-form videos.

> Create multiple edits, variations, and recurring content series from shared footage.

> Bring original ideas, humor, and creative direction to every project.

> Edit everything from clean, lo-fi cuts to intentionally chaotic, effects-heavy videos.

> Stay tapped into social trends, pop culture, and internet humor.

• Takes initiative without being asked.



• Thinks strategically and understands the purpose behind each piece of content.



• Loves organization, systems, and efficient workflows.



• Follows instructions carefully while knowing when to use independent judgment.



• Understands that each influencer has a unique personality, audience, and aesthetic.



• Has a creative eye and pays attention to the smallest details.



• Knows how to prioritize content and make smart decisions about what should be posted first.



• Solves problems independently instead of waiting for instructions.



• Takes ownership of your work and consistently meets deadlines.



• Can balance creativity with organization and productivity.



• Has a "get it done" attitude.



• Wants a long-term position where you can grow professionally.



## ABOUT ME:



A few things you should know:



• I own a social media marketing and influencer management agency.



• We help content creators grow their audience and increase affiliate revenue.



• I move quickly and expect my team to do the same.



• I invest heavily in training and helping my team grow professionally.



• I value reliability, communication, and attention to detail above almost everything else.



• I'm building a team that grows with the company for years, not months.



## ABOUT THE ROLE:



You'll help with:



**Video Editing & Creative Content Development**



• Editing Instagram Reels and other short-form video content for multiple influencers.



• Creating attention-grabbing hooks that encourage viewers to stop scrolling and watch.



• Adding in-app captions, text overlays, and engaging visual elements.



• Adjusting video pacing, transitions, and storytelling to improve content quality.



• Customizing each video to match the influencer's personal brand, aesthetic, personality, and target audience.



• Creating polished Canva graphics, collages, Stories, and other content assets.



**Strategic Content Planning**



• Strategically planning and organizing content for multiple influencer accounts.



• D
 which posts should go first based on content relevance, audience interests, promotional campaigns, and engagement potential.



• Evaluating content priorities rather than simply following a posting schedule.



• Maintaining a balanced content mix, including lifestyle, promotional, educational, and affiliate-driven posts.



• Identifying opportunities to repurpose existing content across different platforms.



• Researching trends, seasonal opportunities, and relevant content ideas.



• Making independent decisions when content schedules need to be adjusted.



**Social Media Scheduling & Publishing**



• Scheduling content using Metricool.



• Managing publishing schedules across Instagram and other social media platforms.



• Preparing captions, hashtags, calls to action, and supporting links.



• Ensuring content is posted at the appropriate time and in the correct sequence.



• Repurposing content for multiple platforms while maintaining brand consistency.



• Monitoring publishing calendars and ensuring posts go live as scheduled.



**Affiliate Marketing & Content Management**



• Uploading and managing affiliate content on LTK, ShopMy, and Amazon Storefront.



• Creating, organizing, and verifying affiliate product links.



• Matching featured products with the correct links and shopping destinations.



• Repurposing social media content into shoppable affiliate posts.



• Coordinating affiliate posts with social media publishing schedules.



• Ensuring product links, descriptions, and affiliate content are accurate.



• Supporting affiliate revenue growth through strategic product promotion.



**Social Media Automation**



• Creating and managing automated comment-to-DM workflows using LinkDM.



• Connecting Instagram posts and Reels with relevant affiliate links.



• Setting up trigger keywords and automated DM responses.



• Testing automations to ensure links and messages work correctly.



• Troubleshooting automation issues and updating workflows as needed.



**Brand Consistency & Quality Control**



• Understanding and maintaining each influencer's unique voice, style, and aesthetic.



• Ensuring fonts, captions, editing styles, graphics, and visuals align with individual brand guidelines.



• Reviewing content for accuracy, quality, and consistency before publishing.



• Making sure scheduled posts, product links, and automations are properly configured.



• Maintaining a polished, professional, and authentic presentation across client accounts.



**Performance & Content Optimization**



• Reviewing available social media insights, engagement metrics, and content performance.



• Identifying which hooks, content formats, and posting strategies perform best.



• Using audience engagement insights to improve future content planning.



• Recommending creative adjustments based on content performance and audience behavior.



• Identifying opportunities to increase engagement, traffic, and affiliate conversions.



**Content Operations & Team Support**



• Managing multiple influencer accounts and deadlines.



• Updating spreadsheets, trackers, content calendars, and shared content libraries.



• Following and maintaining SOPs and workflow documentation.



• Supporting influencer campaigns, brand collaborations, and content deliverables.



• Communicating content updates, priorities, and potential issues with the team.



• Keeping content assets organized and easily accessible.



• Providing general administrative and client support as needed.



## HOURS:



• Starts part-time.



• Opportunity to transition to full-time.



• Weekly team meetings are required.



## IMPORTANT:



Our clients' businesses operate seven days a week.



That does not mean you'll work every weekend.



Most content is planned and scheduled in advance.



However, content must continue publishing on weekends and holidays. If you need time off, that's completely fine. We simply expect proactive communication so content is scheduled before you're away.



This role is best suited for someone who is **organized, dependable, creative, proactive, strategically minded, and comfortable taking ownership of their responsibilities.**

title: Experienced Credit Repair Dispute Specialist
description:
Long-Term Opportunity | Experienced Professionals ONLY



We are looking for a highly experienced, results-driven Credit Repair Dispute Specialist Virtual Assistant to join our growing team long-term.



⚠️ IMPORTANT: WE ARE ONLY LOOKING FOR EXPERIENCED DISPUTERS WHO HAVE PROVEN KNOWLEDGE OF ADVANCED DISPUTE STRATEGIES, EXPEDITED TECHNIQUES, AND A TRACK RECORD OF PRODUCING FAST RESULTS.



We are NOT looking for beginners or individuals who only know how to generate basic dispute letters and wait 30–45 days for responses.



We want someone who understands advanced credit repair, knows multiple legitimate dispute methods, and has hands-on experience obtaining expedited deletions and corrections.



🔥 FAST DELETIONS & ADVANCED DISPUTING EXPERIENCE REQUIRED



You must have experience disputing and successfully resolving inaccurate, incomplete, outdated, or unverifiable information involving:



* Collections

* Charge-offs

* Bankruptcies

* Repossessions

* Foreclosures

* Late payments

* Student loans

* Medical collections

* Hard inquiries

* Judgments and public records

* Closed derogatory accounts

* Other negative credit reporting items



WE ARE ESPECIALLY INTERESTED IN SPECIALISTS WHO HAVE ACHIEVED LEGITIMATE DELETIONS WITHIN 7–30 DAYS.



You should understand how to identify opportunities for expedited results, use appropriate escalation methods, analyze reporting inconsistencies, and develop strategies beyond standard dispute letters.



We understand that not every negative account qualifies for removal and that results cannot be guaranteed. However, we expect applicants to have proven experience identifying legitimate opportunities to obtain faster results.



If you only know how to send generic dispute letters, this position is NOT for you.



RESPONSIBILITIES



* Review and analyze complete 3-bureau credit reports from Experian, Equifax, and TransUnion.

* Identify inaccurate, incomplete, outdated, inconsistent, or unverifiable reporting.

* Develop customized dispute strategies based on each client’s credit profile.

* Utilize advanced, legally compliant dispute techniques and expedited escalation procedures when appropriate.

* Prepare and submit disputes to credit bureaus and furnishers.

* Handle complicated collections, charge-offs, bankruptcies, repossessions, and other derogatory accounts.

* Identify reporting violations, inconsistencies, and legitimate opportunities for faster resolutions.

* Manage multiple clients and dispute rounds simultaneously.

* Track dispute deadlines, bureau responses, deletions, updates, and investigation results.

* Review all results before determining the next dispute strategy.

* Escalate complicated files and unresolved reporting issues when necessary.

* Maintain detailed client notes, dispute histories, and documentation.

* Upload dispute letters, results, and supporting documents into DisputeFox.

* Communicate regularly with customer service, management, and other departments through Slack.

* Use GoHighLevel to manage client information, tasks, pipeline stages, follow-ups, and workflows.

* Properly complete client and task handoffs between departments.

* Keep DisputeFox, Slack, and GoHighLevel updated so the entire team knows where each client stands.

* Follow company SOPs, compliance procedures, and confidentiality requirements.



ADVANCED DISPUTE EXPERIENCE WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We strongly prefer applicants with hands-on experience in the following areas:



Credit Repair & Dispute Strategies



* Traditional bureau disputes

* Direct furnisher disputes

* Advanced credit report analysis

* FCRA Sections 609, 611, and 623

* FCRA Section 605B for legitimate identity-theft cases

* Metro 2 reporting accuracy analysis

* Method-of-verification requests

* Reinsertion disputes

* CFPB complaints and escalations

* BBB complaints

* FTC identity-theft reports when legitimately applicable

* LexisNexis disputes

* ChexSystems disputes

* Early Warning Services disputes

* Complex bankruptcy disputes

* Collection and charge-off reporting disputes

* Repossession reporting disputes

* Expedited resolution opportunities

* Advanced escalation procedures

* Investigation of inaccurate furnisher reporting



Software & Team Management



* DisputeFox

* Slack

* GoHighLevel (GHL)

* LetterStream

* Credit monitoring and 3-bureau report analysis platforms

* CRM management

* Client pipeline management

* Workflow automation

* Task assignments and departmental handoffs

* Dispute tracking and reporting



We are looking for someone who understands WHY a dispute strategy works, WHEN to use it, and HOW to execute it effectively.



The more advanced legitimate credit repair techniques, systems, and strategies you bring to the table, the better.



REQUIREMENTS



* Previous professional credit repair/disputing experience is required.

* Proven experience handling collections, charge-offs, bankruptcies, and other complicated derogatory accounts.

* Strong understanding of advanced dispute methods and expedited resolution opportunities.

* Demonstrated history of obtaining legitimate deletions and corrections.

* Ability to explain previous dispute strategies and results.

* DisputeFox experience is a BIG PLUS.

* Experience working with Slack and GoHighLevel is strongly preferred.

* Ability to manage a high volume of active client files.

* Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.

* Strong written English and professional communication.

* Reliable computer and internet connection.

* Ability to meet deadlines and manage multiple dispute rounds.

* Ability to communicate effectively with multiple departments.

* Comfortable following SOPs, workflows, and compliance requirements.

* Ability to maintain accurate documentation and client records.

* Strict confidentiality when handling sensitive client information.

* Dependable, accountable, and committed to long-term growth.



⚠️ WHO SHOULD NOT APPLY



Please DO NOT apply if:



* You are a beginner with little or no credit repair experience.

* You only know how to generate basic dispute letters.

* You have no experience with advanced dispute strategies.

* You cannot explain your expedited dispute techniques.

* You have never successfully handled complicated derogatory accounts.

* You cannot demonstrate or explain previous results.

* You struggle with managing multiple clients and deadlines.

* You are unfamiliar with organized remote team communication.

* You do not consistently update client files and CRM systems.

* You are looking for a temporary position instead of long-term employment.

* You rely on fabricated identity-theft claims, false documentation, or unlawful dispute practices.



WE NEED SOMEONE WHO CAN BRING EXPERIENCE, ADVANCED KNOWLEDGE, AND REAL VALUE TO OUR TEAM FROM DAY ONE.



LONG-TERM CAREER OPPORTUNITY



We are building a professional, organized, high-performing credit repair team.



We are not looking for someone who only wants a temporary job. We want individuals who are dependable, motivated, team-oriented, and committed to growing with us.



We value employees who take initiative, solve problems, communicate effectively, and consistently produce quality work.



Strong performers will have opportunities to move into leadership positions, take on additional responsibilities, and grow within the company.



📩 HOW TO APPLY



Send your resume and answer ALL of the following questions.



1. How many years of professional credit repair experience do you have?

2. What credit repair software and CRM platforms have you used?

3. Have you used DisputeFox? If yes, for how long?

4. Have you used Slack to manage daily tasks and communicate with a remote team?

5. Have you used GoHighLevel? What features, workflows, and automations have you worked with?

6. How many active client files can you comfortably manage at one time?

7. List ALL traditional, advanced, and expedited dispute methods you have hands-on experience using.

8. What expedited dispute techniques have you successfully used to achieve faster deletions or corrections?

9. Do you have experience obtaining deletions or corrections involving collections, charge-offs, bankruptcies, repossessions, and late payments? Explain your experience.

10. What is the fastest legitimate deletion or correction you have achieved? How many days did it take, and what strategy did you use?

11. Have you successfully achieved documented deletions or corrections within 7–30 days? If yes, explain the types of accounts and methods used.

12. Do you have experience with CFPB complaints, BBB complaints, FTC identity-theft disputes, LexisNexis, ChexSystems, Early Warning Services, and LetterStream?

13. Do you understand Metro 2 reporting standards, FCRA dispute requirements, and how to identify credit reporting inaccuracies?

14. Briefly explain how you analyze a new client’s 3-bureau credit report and determine the most effective dispute strategy.

15. What is your next step when traditional dispute rounds fail to produce results?

16. Have you worked in a system where customer service, dispute specialists, and management hand clients and tasks off between departments?

17. Can you provide redacted examples, case studies, or documented proof of previous successful deletions and expedited results? Do not share sensitive client information.

18. What additional advanced credit repair knowledge, techniques, or skills can you bring to our team?

19. What is your expected hourly rate?

20. How many hours per week are you available, and when can you start?



🚨 IMPORTANT APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS



START YOUR APPLICATION WITH THE EXACT WORDS:



“EXPERIENCED DISPUTER VA”



This lets us know you have read the entire job posting and can follow instructions.



Applications that do not answer all required questions may not be considered.



PRIORITY WILL BE GIVEN TO APPLICANTS WHO HAVE:



✅ Extensive advanced credit repair experience.



✅ Proven knowledge of expedited dispute strategies.



✅ Experience achieving legitimate deletions and corrections within 7–30 days.



✅ Strong experience handling collections, charge-offs, bankruptcies, and repossessions.



✅ Knowledge of CFPB escalations, Metro 2 reporting, and FCRA dispute procedures.



✅ Experience with DisputeFox, Slack, and GoHighLevel.



✅ Ability to manage high-volume client files efficiently.



✅ Documented examples of successful results.



✅ Strong communication, organization, and teamwork skills.



WE ARE NOT LOOKING FOR BASIC LETTER GENERATORS. WE ARE LOOKING FOR EXPERIENCED DISPUTE SPECIALISTS WHO UNDERSTAND ADVANCED STRATEGIES, KNOW HOW TO PURSUE EXPEDITED RESULTS LEGALLY, AND CAN HELP OUR TEAM OPERATE AT A HIGH LEVEL.



SERIOUS, EXPERIENCED APPLICANTS ONLY.

title: Finance Manager / Controller (Daily Reporting
description:
Full time, 40 hours a week, spread across 7 days. Remote, based in the Philippines. Reports to the CEO.



We are a 24/7 business. That is why the week is 7 days and not 5. The hours are normal, the rhythm is not.

We are a two entity, two market, inventory heavy DTC beauty business running on Shopify and Amazon with China direct and 3PL fulfilment. Revenue is not our problem. Visibility is.



We need a qualified accountant who turns a messy, cross border operation into a small set of numbers we can look at every single day and trust. Not a month end role. Not a board deck role. A daily discipline role.



The rhythm is the point: a report lands every morning, seven days a week, including weekends and holidays. We spend money on ads every day, so we need to see profit and cash every day. Weekends are when problems hide.

The Philippines time zone is a deliberate advantage here. You work your morning, the previous European day has just closed, and your pack is in Slack before Amsterdam opens.



You will work alongside our existing external accounting partners (a US accounting firm, Dutch bookkeepers and a cross border accountant) rather than replacing them. They handle statutory and compliance. You own management reporting.



The daily rhythm

Every day, 7 days a week, delivered by 13:00 PHT (around 07:00 CET):

• Cash position across all bank accounts and both entities

• Yesterday’s revenue, gross profit and ad spend by market and channel

• Blended MER and contribution margin after ad spend

• Refunds, chargebacks and payment provider reserve movements

• Any red flag, called out in one line at the top

Weekend versions can be a lighter, largely templated snapshot, but they land.

Every Monday:

• Full management P&L for the prior week

• Contribution margin by SKU, channel and market

• Inventory position and stock cover in weeks

• Rolling 13 week cash flow forecast, updated

• KPI pack for the founding team

Every month:

• Consolidated cross border P&L (NL and US) and balance sheet review

• Variance against plan, with commentary on the why

• Reconciliation sign off across Shopify, Amazon, payment providers, 3PL and the ledger

What You’ll Own Beyond the Reporting

• Cash forecasting: the rolling 13 week forecast, including inventory and purchase order cash planning against production lead times

• Unit economics: true landed COGS per SKU (freight, duty, fulfilment), and contribution margin by SKU, channel, market and cohort

• Channel P&Ls: Shopify DACH, Shopify US, Amazon US, comparable and reconciled

• Payment risk monitoring: reserves, rolling reserves and chargeback exposure

• FX exposure across EUR, USD and PHP

• Invoice verification: supplier and 3PL invoices checked against contracted terms

• Automation: templates, defined metrics, connected data sources. If the daily pack takes two hours by month three, something is wrong



What We’re Looking For

• Philippine CPA, or an equivalent qualification with a strong practical track record

• 4+ years in accounting or finance, including hands on management reporting

• Ecommerce or inventory based business experience

• Advanced Excel or Google Sheets. You have built cash flow models yourself

• Comfortable reconciling data from Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, payment gateways and 3PL reports

• Multi currency and multi entity experience

• Reliable to a fault. A pack that lands 6 days out of 7 is worth a fraction of one that lands 7

• Willing to work a 7 day rhythm with light weekend days, and to cover Philippine public holidays

• Excellent written English and the confidence to tell a CEO a number he will not like

Strong Plus

• Beauty, cosmetics or CPG experience

• Experience reporting for a Western or European company from the Philippines

• BI or automation skills (Looker Studio, Power BI, SQL, Zapier or similar)

• Familiarity with NL and US cross border reporting

• Xero, QuickBooks or a comparable cloud ledger



First 90 Days Looks Like Success If

1. The daily pack has landed every day for 30 consecutive days and leadership trusts it

2. A 13 week rolling cash forecast is live, updated weekly, and reliable enough to make decisions on

3. True landed COGS and contribution margin are known per SKU and per channel

4. The daily pack takes under 45 minutes to produce because the rest is automated



What We Offer

• Fully remote, permanently

• Direct access to the CEO

• Genuine ownership of the finance function as it grows

• HMO health coverage and 13th month pay

• Paid monthly via Wise



What to Include in Your Application

• Your CPA registration number, or the equivalent qualification with the body that issued it

• One management report you built yourself, redacted as needed, so we can see the format and the metrics you chose

• The names of the systems you have reconciled across, and for which business

• Confirmation in writing that you are available on a 7 day rhythm

title: AI Video Editor — 100 Short Skin & Medical Aesthetics Videos (Kling, Veo, Runway, CapCut)
description:
We are a medical aesthetics education company based in Spain. We're hiring an AI Video Editor for a project of 100 short vertical videos (10–20 seconds) for Instagram,
 and Meta ads: realistic, slow-motion "inside the skin" visuals (skin layers, needles, fibers, pores), treatment explainers (microneedling, chemical peels, lasers) and short educational clips. All videos include captions.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Receive a script and a prompt for each scene from us.

• Generate the images (Midjourney, Nano Banana or Freepik) and animate them into video with Kling, Veo or Runway.

• Edit in CapCut: cuts, pacing, word-by-word captions, music.

• Add AI voice-over with ElevenLabs when the script requires it.

• Deliver captioned 9:16 MP4s ready to post, in batches of 10 videos, revisions included.



THE PROJECT AND THE PAY

• 100 videos for USD 1,700 in total (USD 17 per approved video, revisions included).

• Paid per batch: USD 170 for every 10 approved videos, within 3 days of approval.

• Tool allowance: USD 40 per month while you deliver batches, up to 4 months (USD 160 in total for the project).

• Expected pace: 20–30 videos per month.



LATER ON

After the 100 videos there is a second phase: around 50 videos of 3–4 minutes, one per course unit, recapping the key points, in English and in Spanish (we provide the script and the Spanish captions; no Spanish needed). Priced separately. We're looking for someone available to work with us long-term.



REQUIREMENTS

• A portfolio with at least 10 AI-generated videos (image-to-video). Applications without links will not be considered.

• Real experience with Kling, Veo or Runway, and with CapCut captions.

• Your own access to the tools (Kling/Veo/Runway, CapCut, ElevenLabs).

• Good English (scripts and prompts are in English).

• Attention to realism and detail: no deformed anatomy, no text artifacts, no flicker.



HOW TO APPLY

Reply with: (1) links to 10 AI videos you made and which tool you used for each, (2) your OnlineJobs.ph ID Proof score, (3) the word KLING at the start of your message, so we know you read this. Shortlisted candidates do 2 paid tests: two 10–20 second videos from our script, at USD 17 each. If they pass, the 100-video project starts.

title: Business Funding Qualifier / Closer (Recent Funding Experience Required) | GoHighLevel
description:
Hoodrich Credit is hiring an EXPERIENCED Business Funding Qualifier / Closer. You are the first call for incoming funding leads: you review their credit and business profile, decide if they qualify for funding right now, explain our service, and onboard the ones who are a fit. We need someone who works in business funding today and knows what current banks and lenders are actually approving.



RECENT EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED

- You have qualified or closed business funding clients within the last 6 months.

- You know today's approval criteria (score ranges, utilization, inquiries, age of credit, time in business, revenue) for the banks that are approving right now.

- You can tell on a call whether a profile is fundable today or needs work first.

- Applicants without recent funding experience will not be considered.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Work new leads from Slack and GoHighLevel and keep them in the right pipeline stage.

- Schedule and confirm qualification calls; follow up with no-shows, reschedules and undecided prospects.

- Review authorized credit reports with prospects and confirm business details, revenue, time in business and funding goals.

- Qualify against our criteria and today's lender requirements, and escalate borderline files.

- Explain the service, fee, agreement and next steps clearly, without guaranteeing outcomes or timelines.

- Help qualified clients sign the agreement and pay through our approved systems.

- Complete intake records and hand off clean files to the Funding Specialist.

- Post daily calls, qualified leads, closes and collected fees in Slack.



REQUIREMENTS

- Excellent spoken and written English and strong phone and Zoom skills with U.S. clients.

- Recent business funding qualification or sales closing experience.

- Ability to read credit reports accurately and follow qualification criteria without guessing.

- Strong GoHighLevel skills (contacts, pipelines, follow-up workflows), plus Slack, Zoom and e-sign/payment links.

- Professional objection handling and organized follow-through.

- Full-time availability overlapping U.S. business hours (Eastern time).



COMMISSION

On top of base pay, you earn 0.25% of the funding secured for each client you bring in who gets funded (e.g. $10,000 funded = $25 extra).



HOW TO APPLY (applications that skip these will not be reviewed)

1. Subject line: FUNDING QUALIFIER - [Your Full Name]

2. Your resume and your most recent business funding role (company type, dates, what you did).

3. A prospect has a 690 score, 45% utilization, 6 inquiries in the last 6 months and an LLC that is 4 months old. Do they qualify for funding today? Explain why and what you would tell them.

4. How you handle a prospect who wants funding but is hesitant to pay the fee.

5. Your availability, time zone and start date.

Preparing weekly and monthly financial summaries for the Managing Director.

 

Working with our external UK accountants to ensure accurate financial records and compliance, including preparing the workings for VAT returns for their review.

 

2. FRANCHISE NETWORK – MONTHLY BOOKKEEPING

 

You will also be responsible for managing and coordinating the monthly bookkeeping requirements across our growing network of franchise businesses.

 

Responsibilities include:

 

Maintaining bookkeeping records for individual franchisees using Xero.

 

Completing monthly bank reconciliations for franchise businesses.

 

Ensuring income and expenditure are correctly categorised.

 

Reviewing transactions and investigating discrepancies.

 

Monitoring outstanding invoices and financial commitments.

 

Ensuring bookkeeping is completed accurately and on time each month.

 

Maintaining consistent charts of accounts across franchise businesses.

 

Working with our external accountants to ensure records are accurate and ready for statutory and tax reporting.

 

Each franchise must have accurate, organised and up-to-date financial information.

 

3. FRANCHISE FINANCIAL ONBOARDING

 

When new franchise partners join Samba Soccer Schools, you will take responsibility for supporting the financial onboarding process.

 

This includes:

 

Guiding franchisees through the financial setup of their businesses.

 

Coordinating the setup and configuration of Xero.

 

Ensuring the correct chart of accounts is implemented.

 

Supporting the setup of bank feeds and accounting processes.

 

Explaining how franchisees should manage income, expenditure and financial records.

 

Educating new franchisees on bookkeeping responsibilities and financial procedures.

 

Ensuring each franchise follows our standardised reporting structure.

 

Liaising with franchisees and accountants to resolve financial setup issues.

 

Our goal is for every franchise partner to start their business with the correct financial systems, processes and understanding in place.

 

4. FRANCHISE FINANCIAL PERFORMANCE MONITORING

 

A major part of this role involves actively monitoring the financial performance of our franchise network.

 

You will:

 

Review monthly revenue, operating costs and profitability for each franchise.

 

Monitor profit margins and overall financial health.

 

Compare actual results against budgets and forecasts.

 

Identify franchisees experiencing financial difficulties.

 

Monitor trends in revenue, expenses and profitability.

 

Analyse venue-level profitability where data is available.

 

Identify unnecessary costs and opportunities to improve financial performance.

 

Track outstanding franchise fees, royalties and other financial obligations.

 

Produce meaningful financial insights and recommendations.

 

We want someone who can look at financial reports and explain what the numbers mean, why performance is changing and what action should be taken.

 

5. MONTHLY FRANCHISE FINANCIAL REPORTING

 

You will be responsible for preparing and distributing monthly financial performance reports to franchise partners.

 

Each report should provide a clear overview of the franchise's financial performance, including:

 

Monthly revenue.

 

Operating expenditure.

 

Gross and net profitability.

 

Profit margins.

 

Cash-flow position.

 

Performance against budgets or previous periods.

 

Significant changes in income or expenditure.

 

Areas of financial concern.

 

Recommendations to improve profitability.

 

Reports must be accurate, easy to understand and consistent across the franchise network.

 

You will also provide the Managing Director with a consolidated overview of franchise financial performance.

 

6. FINANCIAL EDUCATION & FRANCHISE SUPPORT

 

We want our franchise partners to become financially knowledgeable and capable business owners.

 

You will play an important role in developing their financial understanding and commercial awareness.

 

Responsibilities include:

 

Helping franchisees understand their profit and loss statements.

 

Explaining the difference between revenue, profit and cash flow.

 

Educating franchisees on budgeting and financial planning.

 

Helping franchisees understand their operating costs and profit margins.

 

Explaining how to identify unnecessary expenditure.

 

Supporting franchisees with financial questions.

 

Helping franchisees understand how financial decisions affect profitability.

 

Providing practical recommendations to improve business performance.

 

You must be confident explaining financial concepts in simple, clear English to people who may not have an accounting background.

 

7. EARLY IDENTIFICATION OF FINANCIAL PROBLEMS

 

One of the most important responsibilities of this position is identifying financial problems before they become serious.

 

You will be expected to proactively monitor the finances of both our operating business and franchise network.

 

Examples include:

 

A franchise consistently operating at a loss.

 

Rapidly increasing operating costs.

 

Significant reductions in revenue.

 

Poor cash-flow management.

 

Unpaid invoices or overdue financial obligations.

 

Unusual transactions or financial discrepancies.

 

Potential cash shortages.

 

Franchisees spending beyond their available budgets.

 

Unexpected changes in profitability.

 

Any significant financial concern must be flagged directly to the Managing Director as early as possible, together with an explanation of the issue and recommended actions.

 

We do not want someone who simply reports financial problems after they have happened.

 

We want someone proactive who can anticipate risks and help prevent them.

 

8. FINANCIAL REPORTING & MANAGEMENT DASHBOARDS

 

You will also help develop and maintain financial reporting systems for the wider business.

 

This includes:

 

Preparing monthly management accounts.

 

Maintaining cash-flow forecasts.

 

Creating Excel or Google Sheets financial dashboards.

 

Monitoring key financial performance indicators.

 

Producing weekly financial summaries for management.

 

Comparing performance across franchise businesses.

 

Identifying trends and opportunities for improvement.

 

Supporting the Managing Director with financial analysis and business decisions.

 

We are an AI-forward business: we use modern AI tools throughout our financial workflows, and we will train you on our systems. An interest in working this way is important.

 

REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 

Minimum 2–3 years of professional bookkeeping or accounting experience.

 

Previous experience supporting UK businesses, including familiarity with UK VAT and UK accounting practices.

 

Strong hands-on experience using Xero.

 

Experience managing bookkeeping for multiple businesses or clients.

 

Strong Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets skills.

 

Ability to prepare and interpret profit and loss statements, balance sheets and cash-flow reports.

 

Experience with bank reconciliations and monthly financial reporting.

 

Good understanding of budgeting, profitability and cash-flow management.

 

Excellent written and spoken English.

 

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

 

Excellent attention to detail.

 

Ability to work independently, manage deadlines and take ownership of responsibilities.

 

HIGHLY DESIRABLE

 

Accounting qualification (CPA) or relevant university degree.

 

Experience at an outsourcing/BPO firm serving UK accounting practices.

 

Experience working with franchise businesses or multi-location companies.

 

Experience preparing management accounts and financial dashboards.

 

Experience supporting business owners with financial planning.

 

Experience training or explaining financial concepts to non-finance professionals.

 

THE PERSON WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 

We are looking for someone who is:

 

Highly organised, reliable and trustworthy.

 

Confident working with financial information.

 

Proactive rather than reactive.

 

Commercially minded and interested in business performance.

 

Comfortable communicating directly with business owners.

 

Able to explain complicated financial information simply.

 

Confident identifying problems and recommending solutions.

 

Capable of managing multiple businesses and deadlines.

 

Interested in building a long-term career with our company.

 

We value initiative, ownership and accountability.

 

If you notice a problem, we want you to raise it.

 

If you identify an opportunity to improve profitability, we want you to recommend it.

 

If a franchise partner is struggling financially, we want you to help them understand why and what they can do about it.

 

WHAT WE OFFER

 

$800 USD monthly salary, paid monthly via Wise.

 

Salary reviews after 6 and 12 months, based on performance.

 

Consistent full-time Monday–Friday schedule on a standard Philippine mid shift (2:00pm–11:00pm).

 

Long-term opportunity with a growing UK company.

 

Direct working relationship with the Managing Director.

 

Opportunity to work across multiple businesses.

 

Exposure to franchise operations and business financial management.

 

Clear potential for career progression as the franchise network grows.

 

HOW TO APPLY

 

Please answer the following questions when submitting your application:

 

1. How many years of bookkeeping or accounting experience do you have?

 

2. How many years have you used Xero professionally?

 

3. Have you managed bookkeeping for multiple businesses or clients simultaneously?

 

4. Describe your experience working with UK-based businesses, including any UK VAT work.

 

5. Can you independently prepare monthly management accounts, profit and loss statements and cash-flow forecasts?

 

6. Have you ever monitored the financial performance of a business and recommended improvements? Give a brief example.

 

7. Are you comfortable explaining financial reports to business owners who do not have an accounting background?

 

8. Have you supported the financial onboarding or accounting setup of new businesses?

 

9. This is a full-time, exclusive role. Are you able to commit 100% of your working time to us, with no other clients?

 

10. Are you available to work 2:00pm–11:00pm Philippine time (6:00am–3:00pm UK time), Monday–Friday?

 

11. Are you happy with the salary of $800 USD per month pay?

 

12. When would you be available to start?

 

Please attach your CV and, if possible, an anonymised example of a financial report or dashboard you have previously prepared.

 

IMPORTANT: Start your application with the words "SAMBA FINANCE" so we know you have read the full job description.

 

Shortlisted applicants will be invited to an online interview and a paid practical finance assessment using real (anonymised) company data.

 

We look forward to hearing from you!
