The successful candidate will be responsible for preparing project estimates, evaluating material requirements, reviewing technical drawings, and supporting project planning and procurement. The role may also involve assisting with steelwork and metal fabrication design, including the preparation and modification of technical drawings, depending on project requirements.

Interpret engineering drawings and specifications to support accurate estimates and project execution.

Assist with design adjustments, detailing, and technical documentation as required.

Ensure drawings and supporting documentation are accurate, consistent, and aligned with project requirements.



Project Coordination & Procurement

Support material ordering, procurement activities, and supplier communications.

Assist with project scheduling, progress tracking, and reporting.

Maintain accurate project records, drawings, estimates, and CRM or project management system updates.



Required Skills & Experience

Technical Requirements



Background in Mechanical Engineering, Quantity Surveying, or a related technical discipline.

Experience in quantity surveying, cost estimation, material take-offs, or project pricing.

Ability to interpret engineering drawings, technical specifications, and construction documentation.

Familiarity with AutoCAD and other relevant design or modelling software.

Experience with steelwork, metal fabrication, or technical design is an advantage.

Strong numerical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

High attention to detail and accuracy in estimating and technical documentation.

Good organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects.

Effective communication and coordination skills when working with suppliers and internal teams.

Ability to work independently and meet project deadlines.

title: Part-Time B2B Sales Representative – Sportswear & Team Kits
description:
**Remote | Philippines-Based Applicants | Paid Trial | Hourly Pay + Commission**



## About Bad Padel Co.



Bad Padel Co. is an independent British padel apparel brand with attitude, distinctive designs and a growing range of men's and women's sportswear.



We specialise in custom padel team kits, club clothing and limited-edition apparel, serving customers in the UK and international markets.



We're now looking for an experienced, ambitious B2B salesperson who can help us grow our customer base, develop commercial partnerships and, most importantly, **generate sales**.



Website: 



## The Opportunity



We're offering a part-time position starting with a **paid two-week trial of 10 hours per week**, with the potential to develop into a long-term role.



Your primary focus will be generating sales enquiries and orders for our custom padel team kits and club apparel.



You'll also identify opportunities with sportswear retailers, independent resellers, merchandise businesses and potential distribution partners.



This is a genuine sales and business development role, not a virtual assistant, data entry or social media management position.



We're looking for someone who enjoys selling, understands how to approach potential customers and knows how to turn conversations into business.



## Your Responsibilities



- Research and identify genuine potential buyers in the UK, Europe and international markets.

- Contact padel clubs, team organisers, tournament operators and sports businesses.

- Introduce our custom team kits and clothing services.

- Identify decision-makers and build relationships with prospective customers.

- Generate qualified sales enquiries and requests for quotations.

- Follow up professionally with interested prospects.

- Identify potential wholesale buyers, independent resellers and commercial partners.

- Help develop new business opportunities and repeat orders.

- Maintain accurate records of contacts, conversations and follow-ups.

- Work closely with the founder to progress enquiries into confirmed sales.



You'll receive product information, marketing materials, guidance and approved commercial information.



You will not be responsible for garment design, manufacturing or handling customer payments.



## Who We're Looking For



**Essential requirements:**



- Proven experience in B2B sales, outbound sales or business development.

- Excellent spoken and written English.

- Confidence communicating with business owners and decision-makers.

- Experience generating genuine sales opportunities.

- Ability to research, qualify and approach potential customers.

- Strong communication and follow-up skills.

- Self-motivated, organised and results-driven.

- Reliable computer and internet connection.

- Comfortable working independently.



**Highly desirable experience:**



- Sportswear, fashion or clothing sales.

- Custom uniforms or teamwear.

- Promotional merchandise.

- Wholesale or distribution.

- International B2B sales.

- Selling to UK, European or US customers.

- Cold calling,
 outreach and relationship development.



Experience in padel or tennis is an advantage but not essential.



## Working Hours



**Initial paid trial: 10 hours per week for two weeks.**



Flexible working arrangements, although some availability during UK business hours will be required.



This is a fully remote position.



Successful applicants may be offered ongoing part-time work with the possibility of increased hours.



## Compensation



**Base pay: $4 USD per hour.**



**Sales commission: 10% on eligible net product sales personally generated.**



Commission applies to qualifying completed and paid orders, excluding shipping, taxes, refunds and discounts, subject to agreed attribution, profitability and payment terms.



Full commission terms will be confirmed in writing before the trial begins.



There is potential for increased hours, continued employment and additional earning opportunities based on performance.



## What Success Looks Like



We're not looking for someone who simply sends hundreds of generic messages or produces spreadsheets full of names.



We want someone who understands sales and can find genuine commercial opportunities.



During the trial, we'll assess:



- The quality of potential customers identified.

- Conversations with genuine commercial decision-makers.

- Qualified sales enquiries and quotation requests.

- Ability to build relationships and follow up.

- Commercial judgement and initiative.

- Progress towards actual paying orders.



We value honesty, reliability, enthusiasm and results.



## How to Apply



Please answer the following five questions in your application:



**1.** What B2B products or services have you previously sold?



**2.** Tell us about one specific sale, customer account or commercial opportunity you personally helped secure. What was the result?



**3.** Have you previously sold to businesses in the UK, Europe or USA?



**4.** If you joined Bad Padel Co., how would you find potential customers for custom padel team kits?



**5.** Are you available for a paid two-week trial working 10 hours per week at $4 USD per hour, plus commission?



**Please also provide a 60-second voice recording in English**, introducing yourself and explaining your relevant sales experience.



Start your application with the word **PADEL** so we know you've read the full job description.



Applications without relevant sales experience or answers to the questions may not be considered.



**Bad Padel Co.**



*Padel Gear With Attitude.*

title: Solutions Engineer, Financial Services
description:
ABOUT MILEMARKER

Milemarker is the data infrastructure behind advisory firms, broker-dealers, and aggregators. Wealth management firms run on disconnected systems: custodians, CRM, portfolio accounting, planning, and market data. Milemarker gives them one data foundation to run their business on.



ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Solutions Engineer, you are the technical partner in every deal. You learn how a firm's data actually moves today, from custodians and market data feeds to CRM and portfolio accounting, and design how Milemarker will make it work better. You sit between our growth team, our implementation team, and our customers, and you make sure what we sell is what we build.



This role is built for someone who already knows financial data from the inside: security reference data, pricing, corporate actions, entitlements, and the vendors that supply them. If you have spent time at a market data or financial information company, you will recognize the problems our customers bring us.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Lead technical discovery with RIAs, broker-dealers, and other prospects to map their current systems, data flows, and pain points.

- Design solutions across the Milemarker platform, including the Data Engine, integrations, Console, and Command Center.

- Build and deliver tailored demos and proofs of concept using real customer scenarios.

- Write SQL against sample and live data to prove out reporting, metrics, and data quality approaches.

- Scope integrations with custodians, CRMs, portfolio management systems, and market and reference data providers.

- Advise customers on security master, pricing, and reference data questions: identifiers, data licensing, and how vendor feeds map into their books.

- Write clear solution designs and statements of work, then hand them off cleanly to implementation.

- Bring customer feedback back to Product so the roadmap reflects what firms actually need.



WHAT YOU'LL BRING

- 3+ years in a solutions engineering, sales engineering, consulting, or technical implementation role in financial services.

- Strong financial services domain knowledge: securities, accounts, positions, transactions, pricing, and how firms report on them.

- Advanced SQL. You are comfortable writing joins, window functions, and CTEs on messy, real-world data.

- Familiarity with wealth management technology: custodial data, CRM, portfolio accounting, performance reporting, or billing.

- The ability to explain technical tradeoffs to a COO and a data engineer in the same meeting.

- Strong written and spoken English, and genuine enjoyment of time with customers. This is a people-facing role.



HUGE PLUS

- Experience at LSEG (including Refinitiv), Thomson Reuters, or a similar financial data company such as Bloomberg, FactSet, S&P Global, Morningstar, or Broadridge.

- Hands-on work with market data, reference data, or entitlement platforms.



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with Snowflake or another modern cloud data warehouse.

- Familiarity with APIs, data pipelines, and ETL/ELT tooling.

- Experience at an RIA, broker-dealer, or wealthtech vendor.

MORALVE | JOB DESCRIPTION

Department: E-commerce Operations | Reports To: Operations & Supply Chain Manager

Employment Type: Full-Time | Work Arrangement: Remote



POSITION OVERVIEW

MORALVE is seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, resourceful, and proactive E-commerce Operations Assistant to support the daily operations of our growing e-commerce business.



This versatile, hands-on role covers marketplace and account health monitoring, inventory tracking, customer service, logistics coordination, data entry, administrative support, and ongoing system and database maintenance.



The primary purpose is to ensure daily operations run smoothly, information remains accurate and current, and recurring tasks are monitored, documented, and completed. The assistant works closely with the Operations & Supply Chain Manager across Amazon and other e-commerce marketplaces.



We value reliability, initiative, follow-through, adaptability, and willingness to learn as much as previous technical experience. As familiarity develops, the role can progress from task execution toward independent ownership of routine workflows, exception identification, and project coordination.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Marketplace Account Monitoring & Maintenance

• Perform daily and recurring checks across Amazon and other assigned marketplaces.

• Monitor account health, notifications, alerts, warnings, and pending action items.



2. Inventory Monitoring & Maintenance

• Monitor inventory availability and stock health across marketplaces and inventory systems.

• Track replenishments, transfers, inbound activity, and receiving updates.

• Update inventory trackers and compare internal data against marketplace records.



3. Customer Service & Customer Experience Support

• Monitor and respond to routine customer inquiries using established guidelines and templates.

• Support order inquiries, delivery concerns, returns, refunds, and replacements within approved authority.

• Track unresolved cases, document actions, and follow up to closure.

• Identify recurring product or service issues and escalate sensitive or nonstandard cases.



4. Logistics, Shipment & Order Monitoring

• Monitor shipment and logistics updates, communications, and operational notifications.

• Maintain shipment trackers and milestones, including estimated arrival, delivery, and receiving.

• Assist with Amazon FBA, AWD, and other marketplace inbound monitoring.

• Record shipment references and organize supporting documents.

• Follow up on missing routine updates and flag delays or discrepancies.



5. Purchase Order & Supplier Coordination Support

• Maintain purchase order records, production updates, and related tracking systems.

• Monitor supplier communications, completion dates, inspection updates, and outstanding information.

• Collect quotations, documents, and routine supplier information.



6. Data Entry, Database & Tracker Maintenance

• Perform accurate recurring data entry and maintenance in spreadsheets, trackers, and databases.

• Update records using verified
s, reports, marketplace information, and supplier communications.

• Identify duplicate, missing, outdated, or inconsistent data.

• Assist with historical backtracking, cleanup, cross-checking, and reconciliation.

• Follow established data standards, formatting, and naming conventions.



7.
, Communication & Task Management

• Monitor assigned operational inboxes and channels; categorize and label communications.

• Identify and execute routine actions, follow-ups, documentation, and escalation.

• Track outstanding requests and pending responses.

• Communicate updates to internal and external stakeholders as appropriate.



8. Document & File Organization

• Download, rename, categorize, and store operational files according to company standards.

• Organize product, shipment, purchase order, inspection, supplier, and customer service documents.

• Support historical file cleanup and ensure records are traceable to their transactions.



9. Routine Operational & Administrative Support

• Complete assigned daily, weekly, and monthly checklists and maintenance tasks.

• Assist with account checks, reporting, data collection, research, and administrative activities.

• Support routine coordination across departments and evolving business needs.



10. Project Coordination & Process Improvement

• Maintain assigned project boards, task lists, deadlines, and documentation.

• Track deliverables, follow up on action items, and report blockers early.

• Assist with small operational projects and SOP documentation.

• Suggest practical improvements to accuracy, organization, and efficiency.



QUALIFICATIONS

Required

• Experience in at least 3 areas: : e-commerce operations, virtual assistance, administrative support, customer service, marketplace management, inventory/order management, logistics support, or data entry.

• Working knowledge of Google Sheets and/or Microsoft Excel, including basic formulas, sorting, filtering, and organizing data.

• Strong attention to detail, organization, written and verbal English communication.

• Ability to interpret
s, spreadsheets, reports, and operational systems and determine routine next steps.

• Ability to manage recurring responsibilities, follow SOPs, and work independently in a remote environment.

• Reliability, accountability, problem-solving ability, and willingness to learn.



Preferred

• Experience with Amazon Seller Central or similar platforms.

• Familiarity with marketplace account health, listings, inventory, orders, and e-commerce customer service.

• Experience with Google Workspace and project tools such as 
, ClickUp, Asana, or Notion.

• Basic familiarity with Amazon FBA/AWD, shipments, purchase orders, and replenishment.

• Experience working with suppliers or logistics providers and maintaining SOPs or operational trackers.



KEY COMPETENCIES

Attention to Detail - Maintains accurate records and recognizes inconsistencies.

Reliability & Consistency - Completes recurring responsibilities on time.

Ownership & Accountability - Takes responsibility and follows tasks to completion.

Proactiveness - Identifies missing information, pending actions, and potential issues.

Problem-Solving - Investigates and proposes possible solutions before escalation.

Learning Agility - Learns new tools and processes quickly.

Organization & Prioritization - Distinguishes urgent issues from routine tasks.

Communication & Follow-Through - Provides timely updates and closes loops.

Adaptability - Supports changing needs across operational functions.

Process Discipline & Judgment - Follows SOPs and recognizes when approval is required.



PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS

• Complete daily, weekly, and monthly responsibilities accurately and on time.

• Keep operational records complete, consistent, and up to date.

• Identify and report marketplace, inventory, customer service, and logistics issues promptly.

• Track open inquiries and action items through resolution.

• Communicate progress, challenges, and blockers proactively.

• Gradually manage assigned recurring workflows with less supervision.



WORK SCHEDULE & BENEFITS

Work Schedule: Full-time, 40 hours per week

Work Arrangement: Remote

13th Month Pay: Provided annually

Paid Holidays: Paid Philippine Regular and Special Non-Working Holidays

Paid Time Off (PTO): 5 paid leave days per year

Team Environment: Collaborative and supportive remote team

Professional Growth: Hands-on exposure to e-commerce tools and operations



GROWTH OPPORTUNITIES

Initially, the role focuses on learning MORALVE's systems, completing recurring tasks accurately, and maintaining reliable records. With demonstrated consistency, accountability, and judgment, the assistant may progress toward independent ownership of operational processes, advanced marketplace and inventory responsibilities, reporting and reconciliation, workflow improvement, and cross-functional project coordination.





If these resonate with you, we’d love to hear from you!

Ready to apply?

Click (or copy the link to your browser) below to get started:

Apply Here 👉 Initial Applicant Form : 



Our application process includes a few steps to help us get to know you better, including some initial questions, online assessments, and a short video introduction.

We recommend setting aside enough time to complete everything in one go. Please read the instructions carefully and make sure all required information is submitted.



Having trouble accessing the form? Feel free to
 us at 
 and we'll be happy to assist.



Thank you for your interest in joining MORALVE! We appreciate the time and effort you're putting into your application and look forward to learning more about you.

title: Finance & Commercial Accounts Administrator Australian Solar & Energy Company | Remote – Philippines | Full-Time
description:
Australian Solar & Energy Company | Remote – Philippines | Full-Time



About iPowr Energy



iPowr Energy is a growing Australian renewable energy retailer specialising in solar, battery storage and home electrification.



We are building a technology-driven business with streamlined systems, clear accountability and a strong focus on financial and operational performance.



We are seeking an experienced **Finance & Commercial Accounts Administrator** to take ownership of four critical financial functions within our business.



This is not simply a bookkeeping or data-entry position. We are looking for someone who understands numbers, works accurately, identifies discrepancies and takes pride in maintaining reliable financial information.



 Your Key Responsibilities



1. Accounts Payable



- Enter and reconcile supplier invoices in Xero.

- Match invoices against purchase orders and agreed pricing.

- Maintain accurate accounts payable records.

- Prepare weekly supplier and contractor payment runs.

- Identify discrepancies, duplicate invoices and overdue payments.



2. Sales Commission Calculations



- Calculate commissions for our sales representatives and appointment setters.

- Apply commission rates, performance bonuses and pricing adjustments.

- Track commission entitlements against customer deposits and completed installations.

- Prepare weekly commission statements and payment schedules.

- Maintain accurate commission records and reconciliations.



3. Cash Flow Management



- Maintain and update our rolling cash flow forecast.

- Track expected customer receipts, supplier payments and operating expenses.

- Reconcile actual cash movements against forecasts.

- Identify upcoming cash requirements and potential shortfalls.

- Provide clear weekly cash flow reporting to management.



4. Job Gross Profit Reporting



- Calculate forecast gross profit on every sale before installation.

- Reconcile actual revenue and costs following installation.

- Account for equipment, installation labour, commissions, finance fees and variations.

- Identify discrepancies between forecast and actual margins.

- Prepare job profitability and margin variance reports.



What We're Looking For



Essential requirements



- Minimum 3 years' experience in bookkeeping, accounts payable, finance administration or management accounting support.

- Strong practical experience using Xero.

- Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, including formulas, lookups and reconciliations.

- Experience preparing financial reports and maintaining cash flow forecasts.

- Strong numerical accuracy and attention to detail.

- Excellent written English and communication skills.

- Ability to work independently, meet deadlines and manage competing priorities.



Highly regarded



- Experience calculating sales commissions or incentive payments.

- Experience with job costing, gross profit reporting or project-based accounting.

- Experience supporting an Australian business.

- Familiarity with CRM systems and financial workflow automation.

- Experience in construction, electrical contracting, solar or other project-based industries.



What We Offer



- Full-time remote position based in the Philippines.

- Long-term opportunity with a growing Australian business.

- Direct communication with Australian management.

- Modern cloud-based systems and documented processes.

- Opportunities to expand your responsibilities as the business grows.



Working hours: 



9am AEST  to 3pm AEST 





Reporting to: Commercial Manager.



How to Apply



Please submit your CV and a short cover letter answering these three questions:



1. Describe your experience preparing accounts payable runs and maintaining cash flow forecasts.

2. Have you calculated sales commissions or prepared job profitability reports? Explain your experience.

3. How would you investigate a job where the actual gross profit is significantly lower than the forecast?



Please include your expected monthly salary in PHP and your earliest available commencement date.



We are looking for someone who can take ownership of the numbers, not simply enter them.

- Edit UGC videos from real creators. These must look like the creator posted them: no logo, no branded end card, music so soft you hardly notice it

- Make videos with our AI brand presenter. Her face, voice and office set are ready. Same face, same light, same voice in every video

- Turn real listings (photos, floor plans, drone shots) into short tours and lifestyle videos

- Short form video for Instagram, TikTok and YouTube Shorts

- Write your own hooks and on screen captions in English

- Look at the numbers with us every week: what works, what does not, and why



THE MOST IMPORTANT RULE



Nobody should be able to tell that our videos are AI. If a viewer thinks "this is AI", the ad is dead. Skin, teeth, eyes, hands, light, background, sound: you catch the fake detail before we do. People in Amsterdam know their own streets, so a fake canal or a wrong building is noticed right away. Quality beats quantity.



YOUR TOOLS



Required, and we will test this:

- Higgsfield, at least 6 months of hands on use: image to video, character consistency, lipsync, voice, and working without wasting credits

- A real editing program: CapCut, Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve

- Image generation for stills and references, for example Nano Banana Pro, Midjourney or Flux



Strongly preferred:

- Experience with the models behind Higgsfield: Kling, Seedance, Wan, Veo

- ElevenLabs or another voice tool, including voice cloning

- Motion graphics in After Effects or similar. We use floating screens and UI cards a lot

- Sound: room tone, background noise, clean mixing



HOW WE WORK



- All tasks are on our ClickUp board. You pick up a task, send the first 15 seconds for approval, and only then finish the full video. That way no credits are wasted on the wrong direction

- You work in our company Higgsfield account. We pay the subscription and the credits, you never pay for your own generations

- We use a time tracker with screenshots (Apploye). We judge on output: your work shows up in Higgsfield and on the board

- Weekly review with the founder and the media buyer

- Our in house tech team automates boring steps for you, like resizing, captions and pulling listings from our CRM into your templates



YOU ARE A FIT IF



- You have at least 6 months of Higgsfield experience and a portfolio to prove it. Send links, not descriptions

- You have made performance video: hooks, variations and testing, not only beautiful single shots

- You understand short form pacing: the first 1.5 seconds d
 everything

- You write good English

- You have stable internet, a computer that can handle editing, and at least 4 hours per day overlap with Amsterdam time

- You are honest about your hours and your progress, and you speak up when you are stuck



NICE TO HAVE



- Experience with real estate, interior or architecture video

- You grew a social media account yourself

- Basic scripting or API experience



HOW IT STARTS



Our selection process asks a lot from you. Come well prepared: know your tools inside out, have your best work ready, and be ready to explain every choice you made in your videos.



1. A test assignment, so we can see your work on a real ApartmentHub video. This assignment is unpaid

2. If your assignment is good: 10 days of training on our tools, our brand presenter and our style. The training is unpaid

3. After the training you start working and get paid



WHAT IT PAYS



- 5 US dollars per hour, full time, 40 hours per week, from the moment you start working after the training

- Paid twice a month, on time

- Higgsfield subscription and credits fully paid by us

- Long term role with a direct line to the founder, no agency layers



HOW TO APPLY (WE FILTER ON THIS)



Applications that skip a step are deleted without reading.



1. Start your message with the word CANAL, so we know you read the whole post

2. Use this subject line: VIDEO EDITOR / [your first name] / [months of Higgsfield experience]

3. In which month and year did you start using Higgsfield? Add a screenshot from your Higgsfield account that shows work from at least 6 months ago

4. Send 3 links to videos you made yourself. For each one, say which tools you used and how long it took

5. In 3 sentences: you need the same face in 20 different clips. How do you do it?

6. Which other programs do you use every week, and what do you use them for?

7. Confirm that you can work 40 hours per week with a time tracker, with at least 4 hours per day overlap with Amsterdam time

8. Confirm that you accept the unpaid test assignment and the 10 days of unpaid training before the paid work starts



Bonus that moves you to the top of the pile: take any listing photo from a public real estate website, turn it into a 10 to 15 second video the way you would post it for us, and send the link. We review those first.



Less than 6 months of Higgsfield experience? Please do not apply.



We reply to everyone who follows the steps above.

title: Retention Specialist
description:
Owns subscriber retention, churn and lifetime value (LTV) across
 flows, cancellation,

dunning and rewards for SoFyre's ecommerce business. Remote. Reports to the Head of Growth

Marketing.



Purpose

Your job is to keep every SoFyre subscriber subscribed for as long as possible. This role is extremely

important to the growth of our brand: every month a customer stays adds directly to our LTV.

You've worked in retention or lifecycle marketing for a subscription ecommerce brand before. You

know why customers stay, why they cancel and what would change their mind.

You've built and split-tested flows in Klaviyo, and you can show the churn and LTV gains your tests

added.



You're detail-obsessed. You QA everything before a customer sees it, and you treat every

cancellation as data.

Your purpose at SoFyre is to improve LTV and reduce churn of our current subscribers.

Primary Roles



First 90 days:

• Learn our customer, products and subscription model; read cancellation reasons, reviews and

support tickets

• Audit every live Klaviyo flow, the cancellation flow, dunning retries and the rewards journey

• QA all customer-facing flows and fix broken logic, links, timing and copy

• Set a baseline for churn, LTV, save rate and failed-payment recovery

• Build a retention testing roadmap and launch the first 2 tests



Ongoing:

•
 flows: split test retention
 flows on Klaviyo (subject lines, timing, offers, content) and

log every result

• QA: check every flow before it is sent to customers (triggers, filters, links, discounts, rendering,

personalisation)

• Cancellation flow: A/B test save offers, skip, pause and swap options, and win-back paths

• Dunning: A/B test retry timing, frequency and failed-payment messages to recover more revenue

• Rewards: A/B test reward journeys and loyalty milestones that keep subscribers active

• Customer insight: turn cancel surveys, support tickets and subscriber data into clear reasons

people leave, and what they need to stay

• Write a short test brief (hypothesis, variant, metric, sample size, run time) before every test

• Work with our CRO and customer support teams on subscription sign-up, cancellation and billing

issues

• Weekly churn, LTV and retention report; daily status update, Monday plan and Friday review

SoFyre · Retention Specialist Page 1



Qualifications

• Must have: 3+ years in retention or lifecycle marketing at a subscription ecommerce or DTC

brand. Applicants without subscription ecommerce experience will not be shortlisted.

• Advanced Klaviyo: flows, segments, split tests and reporting

• Has run A/B tests on cancellation flows, dunning or loyalty programs, with results to show

• Experience with Shopify and subscription apps (for example Recharge, Skio or Loop)

• Comfortable with retention metrics: churn, LTV, cohort retention, save rate, recovery rate

• Strong copywriting for
 and on-site messages

• Fluent written English



Character Traits

• Curious about why customers leave

• Rigorous and honest with numbers

• Obsessive about QA

• Customer-first

• Owns losing tests and learns from them

• Moves fast without breaking live flows



This is NOT For You If

• You've never worked at a subscription ecommerce brand

• You haven't worked hands-on in Klaviyo

• You've never run a proper A/B test, or call tests after two days

• You'd rather send campaigns than build and test flows

• You don't enjoy reading customer feedback or digging into data

• You need someone to tell you what to do next

Hours

• Remote, flexible hours with some overlap with US Eastern time



Growth Potential

With strong performance, growth paths include:

• Head of Retention

• Head of Growth

title: AI Product Video Creator & Editor — Higgsfield + ElevenLabs
description:
Higgsfield + ElevenLabs | Project-based | $30 per video



We’re looking for an experienced AI video creator and editor to make short product videos for our supplement brands. We provide the scripts, product images and clear written instructions. You turn them into polished videos for Amazon and social media.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Read our script and instructions, then plan and create the required scenes.

• Prepare starting images using our real product photos and artwork.

• Generate video clips in Higgsfield.ai and fix problems such as distorted packaging, strange movement or inconsistent scenes.

• Create a clear, natural voiceover in ElevenLabs and check pronunciation.

• Edit the clips and voiceover together. Add captions, on-screen text, licensed music and a clean ending.

• Keep product labels, names, serving amounts and supplied wording accurate. Follow our instructions for product claims.

• Deliver the finished MP4, voiceover file and editable project/source files. Make the agreed revisions after our feedback.



PROJECT AND PAYMENT

• Project-based freelance work, paid at US$30 per finished video.

• We expect approximately 20–30 videos overall, paid individually at US$30 per finished video.

• Videos will typically be 15–30 seconds long.

• The US$30 rate covers one agreed script, one agreed video format/aspect ratio and one consolidated round of revisions.

• Extra hooks, different lengths, additional formats or major changes outside the agreed brief will be discussed before work starts.

• Videos will be assigned individually as needed, with a separate script, instructions and agreed deadline for each one.



WHAT WE PROVIDE

• Scripts, step-by-step creative instructions, product photos and brand assets.

• Paid access to Higgsfield.ai and ElevenLabs.

• Other reasonably priced software you need, with approval before any purchase or subscription.

• Clear feedback and agreed deadlines for each assignment.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

You should already have experience creating AI product videos and editing them into finished ads. You must be comfortable working with Higgsfield, ElevenLabs and a video editor such as Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or CapCut.



We need someone who can follow an English brief, work independently, spot visual mistakes and solve production problems. Experience with physical products, e-commerce ads or supplement brands is helpful. Accurate packaging, natural voiceovers and clean editing matter more than flashy effects.



HOW TO APPLY

 your application to 
 with the subject line “AI Product Video Creator” and include:

1. Your written résumé/CV.

2. Links to 2–3 relevant videos you personally created. Tell us which parts you made and which tools you used.

3. Your experience with Higgsfield and ElevenLabs, plus your preferred editing software.

4. A short explanation of how you stop AI from changing a product’s bottle, packaging or label.

5. Your usual turnaround time for one video, how many you can finish per week and when you can start.

6. Confirmation that the US$30 rate and scope work for you, plus any additional software you would need.



Please include actual video examples. We want to see your ability to take a script and product images through to a complete, usable product video.

title: Senior Vacation Rental Listing & Distribution Specialist
description:
Airbnb | 
 | Vrbo | PMS & Channel Management



Remote | Full-Time | Philippines



About Cabin Living



Cabin Living is a growing Norwegian vacation rental management company specializing in premium cabins, mountain apartments, and holiday properties.



We manage approximately 110 properties and distribute our listings through major international booking platforms, including Airbnb, 
, Vrbo, and several additional channels.



Our property portfolio is growing rapidly, and we are looking for a highly experienced specialist who can help us bring new properties online quickly, accurately, and professionally.



This is not an entry-level Virtual Assistant position. We are looking for someone who has already done this work extensively and knows how to manage the entire listing setup and publication process.



Your Main Responsibilities



You will work closely with our Property & Distribution Manager and take responsibility for the technical setup, preparation, and publication of new vacation rental properties.



Your responsibilities will include:



Creating, configuring, and publishing high-quality vacation rental listings on Airbnb, 
, and Vrbo.



Working with property management systems (PMS), channel managers, and distribution platforms.



Setting up property information, amenities, descriptions, photos, house rules, and booking conditions.



Configuring pricing, minimum stays, seasonal restrictions, availability, and channel-specific settings.



Ensuring correct calendar synchronization across all connected platforms.



Collecting and verifying owner-blocked dates and personal-use periods before publication.



Identifying missing information and proactively following up with our Property & Distribution Manager.



Verifying that cleaning arrangements, access instructions, and essential operational information are complete.



Performing detailed quality checks before listings become available for booking.



Checking published listings to ensure that prices, availability, restrictions, and descriptions are displayed correctly.



Troubleshooting listing errors, synchronization problems, and distribution issues.



Maintaining accurate property information across our systems.



Helping us improve and streamline our onboarding and publication procedures.



What We Are Looking For



We are specifically looking for candidates with substantial hands-on experience in vacation rental listing creation and OTA distribution.



Required qualifications:



At least 2 years of relevant experience managing vacation rental listings.



Strong practical experience with Airbnb and 
 listing setup and management.



Experience with Vrbo.



Experience working with a PMS or channel manager.



Excellent understanding of availability calendars, owner blocks, pricing, booking restrictions, and synchronization.



Ability to work independently and manage multiple property launches simultaneously.



Strong attention to detail and excellent organizational skills.



Excellent written English.



A proactive mindset and the ability to identify and solve problems without constant supervision.



A major advantage if you have experience with:



iGMS



Guesty



NextPax



PriceLabs or Beyond Pricing



Touch Stay



Multi-channel distribution for professional vacation rental management companies



Building or improving listing publication workflows and checklists



What Success Looks Like



We want to significantly increase the number of new properties we can launch without compromising quality.



You will help us establish a reliable and efficient publication process where:



New properties are prepared and published quickly once all required information is available.



Owner-blocked dates, pricing, and booking restrictions are always verified before activation.



Listings are accurate and consistent across distribution channels.



Technical issues are identified and resolved proactively.



Every property passes a documented pre-publication quality check.



Our Property & Distribution Manager can focus on coordination, owner onboarding, and quality management rather than repetitive technical listing tasks.



Why Join Cabin Living?



We are an ambitious and growing company with significant opportunities for further expansion.



You will join an international team and play an important role in developing a scalable vacation rental management operation.



We value people who take ownership, work independently, suggest improvements, and deliver measurable results.



For the right person, this is an opportunity to become a key specialist in our growing distribution team.



How to Apply



Please answer the following questions when applying:



How many years have you worked specifically with vacation rental listing creation and publication? Which platforms have you personally used?



Which PMS or channel management systems have you worked with, and what was your responsibility in those systems?



Approximately how many new vacation rental properties have you personally prepared and published, and how many could you typically complete in one working day when all required information was available?



How do you ensure that owner-blocked dates, pricing, and booking restrictions are correct before a new listing becomes available for booking?



Please include your expected monthly salary in PHP and your availability to start.



Important: We are looking for direct, practical experience. Please describe your actual responsibilities and results rather than providing general answers about customer service or virtual assistance.

title: Crypto BD Lead: $100 Per Qualified Call + Uncapped Partnership Revenue (Player-Coach)
description:
Part-time: 20 hrs/week | $10/hr base + $100 per appointment you book + overrides and deal bonuses, no cap | Remote | Crypto/DeFi



At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month from base and appointment bonuses alone, before any partnership revenue, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗚𝗠𝗜



GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).



LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.



Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.



We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲



One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗰



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2 personally booked, target 5 team total, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗼𝘄𝗻



1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ on our Reach/Health/Access rubric passes to the founder. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:



Positive reply → meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.



Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."



"Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.



If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves. All activity is logged in our tracker same day. Unlogged work doesn't exist and doesn't pay.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.



If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show.



Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



𝗧𝗶𝗺𝗲 𝗮𝗹𝗹𝗼𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin



Building internal tools, assigning books, refining meeting formats, and polishing trackers do not count toward anything. If the team is below target, your personal outreach time goes up.



𝗙𝗶𝗿𝘀𝘁 𝟯𝟬 𝗱𝗮𝘆𝘀 (𝗽𝗮𝗶𝗱 𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗮𝗹)



Week 1: full audit of every rep and the current pipeline, clean pipeline and reporting live, personal outreach started.

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Zero held by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review.

Day 30: 2+ qualified appointments held per week pace, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 3+/week.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗲𝗻𝘀𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week



Minimum Requirement: 2 qualified appointments held per week that you personally booked. Your base pay covers these first two. Every additional personally booked appointment pays $100, and every rep-booked appointment pays you the $30 override, starting from the first. The 30-day trial milestones above set the ramp: 2+ held by Day 14, 2+/week pace by Day 30.



$100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked beyond your weekly minimum of 2

$30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked



𝗣𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽 𝗿𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗻𝘂𝗲, 𝘁𝘄𝗼 𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗲𝘀:



Partnerships YOU originated: you earn the full rep package.



- Commission: 20% of all upgrade fees generated by the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- Launch Bonus: 3% of the total dollar value of bonds minted through the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- No ceiling on either.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗸𝘀 𝗹𝗶𝗸𝗲 𝗼𝗻 𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽:



- Mints $100,000 and generates $15,000 in upgrade fees: $3,000 + $3,000 = $6,000

- Mints $200,000 and generates $30,000 in upgrade fees: $6,000 + $6,000 = $12,000



Partnerships your REPS originated: you earn a 20% override on everything the rep earns from that partnership, both their 20% commission on upgrade fees and their 3% launch bonus, for the same 180-day window. Paid by GMI on top of their earnings, never deducted from them.



Every partnership has exactly one originator of record in our tracker, so lanes never stack on the same deal.



Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships.



No cap on any of the above. One appointment bonus per call ($100 personal OR $30 override, not both).



Appointment bonuses paid after the call happens and the founder confirms it met the standard.



Base and appointment bonuses paid 50/50 in ETH and $GMI, with the GMI portion on an 18-month vesting schedule. Commission are paid bi-weekly as your 20% share of the $GMI collected in upgrade fees (fully liquid, no vesting), so your cut never depends on GMI price. Launch bonus is 3% of the USD value of bonds at time of mint, paid bi-weekly in ETH at the average ETH price over the 14 day payroll period.



𝗥𝗲𝗾𝘂𝗶𝗿𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀



- Crypto-native: DEXs, launchpads, liquidity, TVL, ecosystems, no googling required

- Prior crypto BD, partnerships, lead-gen, or appointment-setting experience with calls you personally booked

- Experience managing contractors or reps against numbers, and comfortable cutting non-performers

- Excellent written English, comfortable messaging founders and senior decision-makers

- Organized: CRMs, trackers,
, X, LinkedIn,
, outreach platforms (we use Saleshandy)

- 3+ hrs daily overlap with GMT+7/+8

- Responsive within 10 minutes during your agreed working block unless on a scheduled call



𝗪𝗼𝗿𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗮𝗿𝗱𝘀



Outcomes over activity. Calls held over calls promised. Decision-makers over moderators. Explicit interest over vague networking. Exact numbers over narratives. Problems escalated the day they appear. No hiding bad weeks. No perfecting systems that don't produce calls. The founder never manages your reps.



𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝘁𝗼 𝗮𝗽𝗽𝗹𝘆



Applications missing any item are auto-rejected. Send:



1. IMPORTANT: Your subject line must start with BOND OPS .

2. Loom video (2-3 min): who you are, your crypto experience, the most qualified appointments you've personally booked in one month, and how you'd produce 5 qualified GMI partnership calls per week.

3. In writing (3-4 sentences): what a launchpad is and why one would want LP Bonds for its projects.

4. Scenario: "Your reps sent 250 targeted messages in one week, received 18 positive replies, and booked zero qualified calls. What do you inspect, and what do you change in the next 48 hours?"

5. One target for GMI (a DEX, launchpad, or ecosystem): why it's qualified, the exact role you'd contact, the channel, and the personalized first message you'd send.

6. Your
 handle, available hours in GMT+8, and earliest start date.

title: Business Funding Specialist (Recent 2025-2026 Experience Required) | Client Zoom Applications
description:
Hoodrich Credit is hiring an EXPERIENCED Business Funding Specialist. You will review client files, build a funding plan, and guide U.S. clients through their applications on live Zoom calls. This is not an entry-level role. We only want people who are doing business funding right now and know which banks and lenders are approving today.



RECENT EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED

- You have personally helped U.S. clients get business funding within the last 6 months.

- You know the current banks, credit unions and card issuers that are approving business credit cards and lines of credit right now, plus their current inquiry sensitivity, bureau pulls and approval patterns.

- You can explain what changed in the last year and which lenders no longer work.

- Applicants without recent, hands-on funding results will not be considered.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Pick up new client assignments in Slack and GoHighLevel and confirm intake info and documents are complete.

- Review authorized credit reports, business details, existing banking relationships and documents.

- Build a funding application plan (which lenders, what order, which bureaus) before every client session.

- Lead screen-shared Zoom sessions while clients complete and submit their own applications on their own devices.

- Make sure every application uses accurate, truthful information supported by the client's records.

- Record results, approval amounts, pending decisions and follow-ups in the CRM.

- Follow up on pending decisions and reconsideration calls, and escalate issues fast.

- Generate invoices per the signed agreement and keep pipeline stages current.

- Post a daily activity report in Slack.



REQUIREMENTS

- Excellent spoken and written English and confidence leading live video calls with U.S. clients.

- Proven, recent results in business funding (cards, lines of credit, term loans).

- Strong credit report analysis.

- GoHighLevel, Slack, Zoom and credit-monitoring tools.

- Full-time availability overlapping U.S. business hours (Eastern time).

- Reliable internet with a backup, and a quiet call setup.



Clients complete and submit their own applications. Approvals and amounts are never guaranteed.



COMMISSION

On top of base pay, you earn 0.25% of the funding secured for each client you help get funded (e.g. $10,000 funded = $25 extra).



HOW TO APPLY (applications that skip these will not be reviewed)

1. Subject line: FUNDING SPECIALIST - [Your Full Name]

2. Your resume and how long you have been doing business funding, including your most recent client funded (month/year).

3. List 5 banks or lenders you have gotten clients approved with in the last 6 months, and which bureau each one pulled.

4. Two anonymized recent results (credit profile summary, lenders used, total approved). No private client data.

5. How you prepare for a session and what you do when a client's documents don't match.

6. Your availability, time zone and start date.

title: Work From Home Junior Merchandise Planner & Allocation Specialist (Fashion Retail) | 6am to 2pm PHT, Mon to Fri
description:
SALARY

US$280 per week. Full-time.



HOURS

9:00am to 5:00pm Sydney time (Australian Eastern Time), Monday to Friday.

That is 6:00am to 2:00pm Philippine time now (Australian daylight saving), and 7:00am to 3:00pm PHT from April when daylight saving ends. No night shift.



ABOUT THE ROLE



A well-established premium Australian womenswear brand, selling through its own retail stores and online, is hiring a Junior Merchandise Planner & Allocation Specialist.



This is a junior planner role with a strong category management brief. You will analyse how each category is trading — by style, store and channel — and use that insight to inform allocation, replenishment and buy decisions. You will also own allocation and replenishment day to day. The Planning Manager owns the full open to buy (OTB); you support it with accurate reporting and clear, reasoned recommendations.



This is not a push-the-button allocation role. You must be able to explain, in your own words, how you d
 allocation depth for a new collection, what triggers a transfer or consolidation, and how you use category or sell-through data to rebalance stock. If you cannot walk through those fundamentals clearly, this role is not a fit.



You will report to the Planning Manager, work full-time from home on Sydney hours, and have a clear path to grow your planning career with a stable brand. In your first 30 days you will learn the brand's retail ERP (the business runs on AP21; training is available if you have used a similar system) and the allocation rhythm. By day 90 you will be contributing category insight and recommendations.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Analyse weekly trade by category, style, store and channel, and turn it into clear actions: what to move, replenish, consolidate or mark down, and why

- Track category performance and trends, and use them to inform allocation decisions and support buy recommendations

- Maintain OTB and sales, stock and intake reporting by category, and flag risks against plan early (the Planning Manager owns the full OTB)

- Support seasonal planning, markdown and promotional recommendations, and post-season reviews with category insight

- Own model stock, allocation and replenishment across retail stores and ecommerce in the brand's retail ERP / merchandise system (the business runs on AP21; training is available if you have used a similar system)

- D
 initial allocation depth for new collections and what to hold back for replenishment, using store tiering, capacity, size profiles, last-season performance and planned intake, not gut feel alone

- Run ongoing allocations, store transfers and consolidations using rate of sale, sell-through, weeks cover, stock on hand, inventory age and broken size runs, and bring a clear recommendation rather than waiting to be told

- Prepare weekly and monthly sales, stock, category and allocation reports that lead with insights and recommendations, and improve or automate manual reports and models where you can



MUST-HAVES



- Fluent spoken and written English (non-negotiable)

- Experience as a merchandise planner or junior planner in fashion or premium retail, including hands-on allocation

- Category management understanding: how ranges, categories and stores trade, and why

- Working knowledge of OTB and sales, stock and intake reporting

- Proven stock allocation experience with a fashion retailer, apparel brand or department store

- Hands-on experience with a retail ERP or merchandise planning / allocation system (for example AP21 / Apparel21, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, Cin7, Retail Pro, JDA / Oracle, or similar). AP21 itself is highly regarded but not required if you have done real planning and allocation work in a comparable system

- Can clearly explain, in your own words, how you d
 allocation depth for a new collection (inputs, sequence, hold-back for replenishment, hero vs slow styles)

- Can name the data points and seasonal events that trigger transfers or consolidations, with a real example

- Can show how you use category performance or sell-through data to rebalance stock across stores or channels

- Strong grasp of retail metrics: sell-through, weeks cover, stock turn, rate of sale, inventory age and markdown

- Advanced Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, XLOOKUP / VLOOKUP, formulas, reporting). Shortlisted candidates complete a short Excel analysis task

- Able to work independently, own outcomes end to end, and work Mon to Fri, 9:00am to 5:00pm Sydney time



HIGHLY REGARDED



- Direct AP21 / Apparel21 experience

- Premium or designer womenswear experience

- Building or refining store tiering, capacity or size-profile frameworks

- Allocating across both retail and ecommerce

- Automation skills (VBA, Google Apps Script or similar)

- A passion for fashion and retail



THE RIGHT PERSON



You think like a planner, not only an allocator. You read how a category is trading, recommend the next move, and explain why. You can walk through how a new collection gets seeded, what forces a transfer or consolidation, and how sell-through data tells you when stock is in the wrong place. You look for ways to improve the process rather than wait to be told, and you have a genuine interest in fashion and retail.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application subject line with PLANNER-280 so we know you read the ad. Applications without it, or that skip the questions, will not be reviewed.



1. Attach your updated CV.

2. Answer all three questions below in your own words.

3. Confirm your earliest start date and that you can work Mon to Fri, 9:00am to 5:00pm Sydney time (6:00am to 2:00pm PHT now, 7:00am to 3:00pm PHT from April), at US$280 per week.



REQUIRED QUESTIONS



1. A new seasonal collection has just landed in the warehouse and needs first allocation across retail stores and ecommerce before it goes live. In your own words, walk us through how you would d
 allocation depth from scratch. Cover at least: which data and inputs you would pull before you allocate a single unit (for example last season sell-through by store/style/size, store tiering or capacity, size curves, planned intake, ecommerce demand, category performance); how you would d
 depth by store vs holding back for replenishment; how you would treat hero styles vs slow movers; and what you would check in week one after the drop. Do not give a generic "I would look at sales and send stock" answer. Name the metrics and the sequence.



2. What events or data points would make you recommend a store or channel transfer, or consolidating stock (pulling from some stores / channels into others, or back to DC)? Give specific examples across both trading data (for example weeks cover, rate of sale, sell-through, inventory age, broken size runs, stockouts elsewhere) and calendar / seasonal events (for example end of season, promo window, new collection intake, store refit or closure). For one real example from your past role, say what you saw, what you recommended, who you took it to, and what happened. Answer in your own words.



3. Walk us through a real example of how you used category performance or sell-through data to rebalance stock. In your own words, cover: what category or sell-through data you looked at (for example sell-through or weeks cover by category, style, store or channel versus plan); what told you the stock was in the wrong place; what action you recommended (transfer, replenish, hold back, consolidate or mark down); and what happened. If you do not have a single past example that covers all of this, walk through how you would approach it, naming the metrics and the sequence — not a generic "I would look at the numbers" answer.



Fluent English is required.

title: Solar & Battery Engineer – Electrical Design & Project Management
description:
We are a growing Australian solar and battery company based in Sydney. We are adding a second Solar & Battery Engineer to our engineering team. This is a long-term, full-time remote role working Sydney business hours.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Manage solar and battery projects from design through to installation and completion: scope, schedules, materials, installers, suppliers and sign-off

- Review electricity bills, site photos and customer requirements, and prepare or check PV and battery designs, system sizing and layouts for our sales team

- Review signed proposals before installation: roof type, mounting, switchboard and meter details, equipment compatibility and scope. Flag missing information and errors before the installer arrives

- Check job packs, drawings, technical specs and material lists

- Prepare technical documents, calculations and single-line diagrams for residential and commercial jobs

- Oversee the electrical side of installations and help installers with faults and commissioning using monitoring data, photos and error codes (inverters, batteries, CT placement, metering)

- Handle warranty claims with manufacturers and follow them through to resolution

- Coordinate stock orders, deliveries and installer schedules, and confirm jobs are ready to install

- Write and maintain checklists, SOPs and design rules, and help improve our in-house quoting and design tools



MUST HAVE (applications without these will not be considered)

- Proven experience managing solar and battery electrical work

- Proven experience designing solar PV and battery systems, including system sizing, layouts and single-line diagrams

- Proven project management experience on solar and/or battery installations: planning, scheduling, coordinating installers and suppliers, and delivering jobs to completion

- Degree in Electrical Engineering (or a closely related field)

- Experience with design tools such as Pylon, Aurora Solar, AutoCAD, OpenSolar, PVsyst, SolarEdge Designer or similar

- Strong understanding of inverters, hybrid systems, batteries, switchboards and metering

- Strong written English, careful attention to detail, and you raise problems early

- Reliable computer, fast stable internet and power backup

- Available Monday to Friday, Sydney business hours



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with Australian standards (AS/NZS 4777, AS/NZS 5033, AS/NZS 5139), grid connection or STC paperwork

- Commercial solar experience

- Experience with CRMs, project management software, spreadsheets or AI tools



WORK HOURS AND TERMS

- 40 hours a week, Monday to Friday, 8 hours a day including a 1-hour paid lunch break, within Sydney business hours (8:00 am to 6:00 pm AEST/AEDT)

- Paid weekly

- Performance and pay review after 6 months, then every 6 months

- 10 paid leave days a year after 6 months



HOW TO APPLY

Send your CV, plus:

1. A sample PV or battery design or single-line diagram you have done 

2. A short summary of one solar or battery project you managed from design to completion: system size, your role, team size and the outcome

3. The design and project management software you have used, and for how many years

4. Your internet speed and power backup setup

5. When you can start

Start your message with "SOLAR ENGINEER" so we know you read the full ad. Applications without this will not be reviewed.

title: Sales Representative
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Position: Sales Representative

Job Type: Part-Time

Rate: Starting at $5/hour, depending on skills and experience

Schedule: 4 hours per day, 5–6 days per week

Working Hours: 3:00 PM–7:00 PM California time



JOB DESCRIPTION



We are looking for a Sales Representative who has more than just sales skills. We want someone with the right personality, character, and work ethic someone who knows how to build trust, communicate naturally, and turn conversations into meaningful business relationships.



The ideal candidate is confident, proactive, coachable, and genuinely interested in helping customers. We value integrity, accountability, and consistency just as much as sales experience.



We are not simply looking for someone who can follow a script. We want someone who can think independently, connect with people, handle rejection professionally, and take ownership of their results.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Reach out to potential customers and engage them in professional, natural conversations.

- Build rapport, understand customer needs, and present relevant products or services.

- Follow up with prospects consistently and manage leads throughout the sales process.

- Handle questions, objections, and concerns confidently and professionally.

- Maintain accurate records of conversations, follow-ups, and sales activities.

- Work toward sales targets while prioritizing customer trust and experience.

- Communicate progress, challenges, and results with the team.

- Accept feedback, learn from mistakes, and continuously improve sales performance.



REQUIREMENTS



- Strong spoken and written English communication skills.

- Previous experience in sales, lead generation, appointment setting, customer service, or business development is preferred.

- Confident communication and relationship-building skills.

- Ability to listen carefully, ask good questions, and understand customer needs.

- Strong work ethic, reliability, and a sense of responsibility.

- Ability to handle rejection, stay positive, and remain professional under pressure.

- Willingness to learn, accept coaching, and improve continuously.

- Good organization and follow-through.

- Experience with CRMs, spreadsheets, or sales tools is a plus.



THE PERSONALITY WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Integrity: You are honest, dependable, and keep your commitments.



Initiative: You take action, think ahead, and don't need constant supervision.



Coachability: You accept constructive feedback and apply it instead of making excuses.



Resilience: You can handle rejection without losing motivation or taking it personally.



Emotional intelligence: You know how to read a conversation, listen to others, and communicate respectfully.



Accountability: You take responsibility for your performance, decisions, and mistakes.



Authenticity: You can build genuine connections without sounding robotic, overly scripted, or pushy.



We believe sales skills can be developed, but character, attitude, and the willingness to grow are essential.



WORK SCHEDULE AND COMPENSATION



- Part-time position

- 4 hours per day

- 5–6 days per week

- Schedule: 3:00 PM–7:00 PM California time

- Starting rate: $5/hour, depending on skills and experience



HOW TO APPLY



Please submit your application with the following information:



1. A brief introduction about yourself and your relevant experience.

2. Your previous experience in sales, lead generation, customer service, or other customer-facing roles.

3. An example of how you handled rejection, a difficult customer, or a challenging situation.

4. Why do you believe you would be a good fit for this role beyond your technical sales skills?
