title: Youtube Creative Director - Hybrid/Remote
description:
We're Hiring: YouTube Creative Director (Hybrid / Remote)



Location: Davao City, Philippines (Hybrid) / Remote

Internal Team Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM PHT

Remote / CGE Schedule: Eastern Time (ET)



ABOUT THE ROLE



We're the team behind Shane Hummus, a leading career and finance YouTube channel. We also create content for established business owners, YouTube entrepreneurs, and business coaches.



We're looking for an experienced, creative, and results-driven YouTube Creative Director who understands what makes YouTube videos successful — from content strategy and storytelling to editing, packaging, and channel growth.



This is a hands-on creative role, not just a management position.



You'll work directly with Shane (CEO) and our production team to develop content ideas, create engaging videos, improve channel performance, and help grow multiple YouTube channels.



We're especially interested in candidates who have managed YouTube channels, developed content strategies, and successfully grown channels through their creative direction.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Long-Form Video Editing: Edit engaging talking-head, podcast, and interview videos with strong hooks, storytelling, pacing, B-roll, captions, and retention-focused editing.



YouTube Content Strategy: Develop content strategies aligned with each channel's audience, niche, and business objectives.



Content Planning & Ideation: Research trends, identify high-potential video topics, and plan content calendars.



Creative Direction: Oversee the creative process from ideation and scripting support to editing, thumbnails, and publishing.



YouTube Channel Growth: Identify opportunities to improve views, subscribers, audience retention, and engagement.



Thumbnail & Title Strategy: Collaborate on compelling titles, thumbnails, and video packaging designed to increase click-through rates.



Performance Analysis: Analyze YouTube metrics, including CTR, average view duration, audience retention, and conversions, to improve future content.



Creative Collaboration: Work directly with Shane, clients, and the production team to maintain content quality and consistency.



Additional Creative Projects: Occasionally turn content ideas into clear visual presentations using tools such as Miro and Google Slides.



NON-NEGOTIABLE REQUIREMENTS



Proven long-form YouTube editing experience, particularly with talking-head, podcast, interview, or educational content.



Strong understanding of YouTube-native editing, including hooks, storytelling, pacing, B-roll, captions, and audience retention.



Advanced proficiency with professional editing software, preferably Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects.



A portfolio featuring published YouTube videos, including links to the channels where your work was uploaded.



At least ONE of the following additional skills:



YouTube Thumbnail Design: Experience creating click-worthy thumbnails that improve video packaging and CTR.



YouTube Strategy: Experience with content planning, titles, SEO, analytics, video ideation, and channel growth.



Excellent English communication skills and confidence working directly with the CEO, clients, and production team.



Strong creative judgment combined with a data-driven mindset.



Ability to manage multiple creative projects, meet deadlines, and maintain consistent video quality.



For hybrid applicants: Must be based in Davao City and available to work with our studio team.



PRIORITY QUALIFICATIONS — HIGHLY PREFERRED



Applicants with proven YouTube channel management, content strategy, and channel growth experience will receive priority consideration.



We are especially interested in candidates who have:



YouTube Channel Management Experience: Hands-on experience managing YouTube channels, overseeing content production, and maintaining publishing schedules.



Content Strategy & Planning Expertise: Experience developing YouTube content roadmaps, researching video ideas, and executing content strategies designed for consistent growth.



Creative Director Experience: Previous experience working as a Creative Director or YouTube Content Strategist, leading creative decisions that contributed to channel growth.



Proven Channel Growth Results: A track record of improving views, subscribers, CTR, audience retention, or other measurable YouTube performance metrics.



YouTube Analytics Experience: Ability to interpret YouTube Studio data and turn performance insights into actionable creative decisions.



Candidates who can provide channel links, before-and-after performance results, and examples of YouTube channels they have helped grow will be prioritized during shortlisting.



BONUS POINTS



Background in digital marketing, branding, or viral content creation.



Experience working with YouTube creators, entrepreneurs, coaches, or business owners.



Strong understanding of YouTube SEO, monetization, and audience psychology.



Experience managing multiple YouTube channels or creative projects simultaneously.



Ability to identify emerging YouTube trends and adapt them to different audiences.



Experience using Miro, Google Slides, or similar creative planning tools.



WHAT WE OFFER



The following benefits apply to internal team members.



Year-end bonuses and performance-based incentives tied to content growth.



Health Benefits: HMO, dental, mental health, and telemedicine coverage after six months of tenure.



Paid Time Off: Paid week-long Christmas leave, PTO, and birthday gifts.



Trust-Based Work Culture: No time tracking or micromanagement.



Professional Development: Workshops, training, and opportunities to improve your skills.



Financial & Credit Support: Access to available employee financial support programs.



Real Creative Ownership: Your ideas and decisions will directly influence YouTube content strategy and channel performance.



Direct Collaboration: Work closely with Shane Hummus and an experienced creative production team.



HOW TO APPLY



To be considered, please submit the following:



1. Updated Resume / CV



Include your relevant experience in video editing, YouTube channel management, content strategy, and creative direction.



2. YouTube Video Editing Portfolio



Provide 2–3 published long-form YouTube videos you personally edited.



For each video, include:



Published YouTube video link



Channel name



Your specific role and responsibilities



3. Thumbnail Design or YouTube Strategy Portfolio



Provide 2–3 relevant examples demonstrating at least one of the following:



YouTube thumbnails you designed



YouTube content strategies you developed



Titles, packaging, or content planning work



YouTube analytics or channel growth projects



4. YouTube Channel Growth Experience (Highly Preferred)



If you have previously managed or helped grow YouTube channels, please share:



Channel name and link



Your role in managing or growing the channel



Strategies you implemented



Measurable results, such as growth in views, subscribers, CTR, or audience retention



This information will help us prioritize candidates with demonstrated YouTube growth experience.



APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS



Applying through OnlineJobs.ph?



Start your application message with the word "STORYTELLER" so we know you have carefully read the job description.



Applying via
?



Send your application and portfolio to:







 Subject: YouTube Creative Director (Story Teller) — [Your Full Name]



Important: Applications without published YouTube video links will not be shortlisted.



We're looking for someone who doesn't just edit videos — we're looking for someone who understands YouTube, knows how to develop winning content strategies, and can help turn great ideas into channels that grow.



If that sounds like you, we'd love to see your work.



Apply now and join Team Shane Hummus!

title: Accountant - Australia
description:
Evisory is a Brisbane-based accounting and advisory firm built for the hospitality industry. Our clients are cafés, restaurants, bars and venues – businesses where margins are tight and things move quickly if owners aren’t on top of their numbers.

We’re not a lodgement factory. We work in our clients’ files every day, keep their books current, and give them advice they can actually act on. We’d rather have fewer clients we know well than hundreds we barely talk to.



We’re looking for an Accountant to take ownership of a portfolio of hospitality clients, lead compliance across all entity types, and be the person clients trust when they need a straight answer. You’ll work closely with the Director, review the work of our bookkeeping and accounting team, and help shape how we deliver advisory as the firm grows.



What you’ll do

▪ Prepare and review financial statements and income tax returns for individuals, companies, trusts and partnerships

▪ Review BAS/IAS and oversee payroll compliance, including STP, super and award-based wages

▪ Manage your own client portfolio – be their main point of contact and keep work moving to deadline

▪ Review and coach the work of bookkeepers and junior accountants, and help build our review processes

▪ Deliver practical advisory: cash flow forecasts, budgets, wage and cost-of-goods analysis, restructures and business purchases

▪ Deal with the ATO on clients’ behalf, including payment plans, objections and queries

▪ Help onboard new clients and scope engagements with the Director



What you’ll bring

▪ CA or CPA qualified (or well progressed towards it)

▪ 5 years’ experience in an Australian practice

▪ Solid working knowledge of tax and compliance across all entity types

▪ Strong Xero skills plus experience with XPM, Dext, Deputy and FoundU

▪ Confidence talking to business owners in plain English and managing your own workload

▪ Experience reviewing others’ work and giving useful feedback

▪ Highly regarded: hospitality client experience, award interpretation, POS integrations, and a registered tax agent pathway



Answer these three questions to be considered:

1. What is your process on compiling EOFY Workpaper?

2. How many years of experience do you have in Australian taxation?

3. Do you also have experience in doing bookkeeping tasks?

title: UGC/Creator Manager
description:
## About the Role



We are looking for an organized, relationship-driven UGC Manager to lead our creator partnerships and user-generated content program. The ideal candidate has managed UGC creators in an agency or e-commerce environment and understands how to produce high-performing, conversion-focused content at scale.



You will oversee the complete creator workflow—from sourcing and outreach to briefing, negotiation, content delivery, and performance analysis. You will also play a key role in our TikTok Shop strategy, including affiliate creator recruitment, content coordination, product seeding, and campaign optimization.



## Key Responsibilities



- Develop and manage relationships with UGC creators, influencers, and TikTok Shop affiliates.

- Source, evaluate, recruit, and onboard creators who align with our brand, products, and target customers.

- Manage creator outreach, negotiations, contracts, product seeding, payments, timelines, and deliverables.

- Create clear, compelling briefs that communicate hooks, angles, scripts, calls to action, and brand guidelines.

- Maintain an organized content pipeline and ensure projects are delivered on time and meet quality standards.

- Review creator submissions and provide clear, constructive feedback and revision requests.

- Collaborate with paid media, creative, social, and e-commerce teams to identify content needs and winning concepts.

- Manage TikTok Shop creator and affiliate relationships, including outreach, sample requests, commission opportunities, and campaign participation.

- Monitor creator and content performance using metrics such as views, engagement, click-through rate, conversion rate, revenue, ROAS, and GMV.

- Identify winning creators, formats, hooks, and messaging, then use those insights to improve future campaigns.

- Maintain a searchable library of creator content, usage rights, agreements, and performance data.

- Stay current on UGC trends, TikTok Shop features, platform policies, creator strategies, and social-commerce best practices.



## Required Experience and Skills



- [2–4]+ years of experience managing UGC, influencer, or creator partnerships in an agency or e-commerce environment.

- Hands-on experience working with TikTok Shop, including its affiliate or creator ecosystem.

- Demonstrated experience managing multiple creator relationships and content projects simultaneously.

- Strong understanding of direct-response creative and content designed to drive e-commerce sales.

- Experience sourcing creators, conducting outreach, negotiating rates, and managing contracts and usage rights.

- Ability to write effective creator briefs, hooks, scripts, and content concepts.

- Strong project-management skills with close attention to deadlines and details.

- Confident communicator who can build positive, long-term creator relationships while maintaining accountability.

- Comfortable analyzing content and sales performance to make data-informed decisions.

- Familiarity with tools such as TikTok Shop Seller Center, creator-management platforms, project-management software, spreadsheets, and shared content libraries.



## Preferred Qualifications



- Experience managing TikTok Shop affiliate programs or performance-based creator campaigns.

- Experience with product seeding, gifting programs, and high-volume creator outreach.

- Familiarity with paid social advertising on TikTok and Meta.

- Experience working with consumer products in [beauty, wellness, fashion, food, fitness, or relevant category].

- Existing relationships with UGC creators, TikTok affiliates, or creator agencies.

- Experience scaling a creator program across multiple products, brands, or client accounts.



## What Success Looks Like



- A reliable pipeline of qualified creators and TikTok Shop affiliates.

- Consistent delivery of high-quality, on-brand content.

- Faster creator turnaround times and fewer missed deadlines.

- Strong creator retention and productive long-term partnerships.

- Measurable improvements in content performance, TikTok Shop GMV, conversions, and return on creator investment.

- A well-organized system for tracking creators, deliverables, costs, usage rights, and results.



## How to Apply



Please submit your résumé along with examples of UGC or TikTok Shop campaigns you have managed. Where possible, include measurable results, the number of creators managed, your responsibilities, and examples of content or creator programs you helped scale.

title: Project Manager / Client Success Manager for US AI Software Company (US hours, $900 to $1,200/mo)
description:
Hi, I'm Trey, founder of Influencer Farm.



We build AI influencer software for businesses in the US. Our clients pay us a lot of money for their build, and each one needs a person they can talk to who makes sure their software is running every single day and looking great.



I'm hiring one person to be the go-to for every client we have. Not a VA. Not a ticket responder. The person our clients know by name.



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO



- Every morning (US time), check every client's software. Are the accounts posting? Are the videos generating? Does everything look right? If something is off, you catch it before the client does.

- Be the single point of contact for our clients. Slack,
, occasional Zoom. You reply fast, you reply clearly, and you never leave a client wondering what's going on.

- Chase our team. When a client needs something from the developer or the setup team, you own it until it's done. You write clear bug reports, set deadlines, and follow up until it's closed.

- Send every client a short weekly update: what's working, what's coming, what we need from them.

- Build and maintain the checklists and SOPs for all of the above so the system doesn't depend on anyone's memory.

- Log into their software EVERY DAY and look for any issues that might arise with development. Quality is KEY!



WHAT I NEED FROM YOU



- 3+ years in a client-facing role for US companies (account manager, project manager, or client success at an agency or SaaS). You've dealt with demanding clients and kept them happy.

- Excellent spoken and written English. You'll be on video calls with American business owners.

- Comfortable with AI tools. You don't need to be a developer, but you need to be the kind of person who opens ChatGPT or Claude without being told to and figures things out. Bonus if you've touched Instagram automation, ManyChat, GoHighLevel, or any AI video tool.

- Organized to the point of being annoying about it. You use checklists and you close loops.

- You can work US business hours (roughly 9am to 5pm Pacific). This is not negotiable since our clients are all in the US.

- Reliable internet and a quiet place for video calls.



PAY AND SETUP



- $900 to $1,200 USD per month depending on experience, paid twice monthly

- Full time, long term. I'm not hiring someone for 3 months. Raises as you prove yourself.

- Direct hire, not an agency



HOW TO APPLY (read this carefully)



Record a CUSTOM video for this job, 2 to 5 minutes, using Loom or any screen recorder with your face on camera. In it, tell me:



1. Why you'd be a great project manager for a social media influencer business that uses AI tools

2. Your experience dealing with customers in the US (specific examples, not generalities)

3. A time a client was unhappy and exactly what you did about it



Start your application with the word "FARM" so I know you read this whole post. Applications without a custom video or that word will not be read. Generic intro videos you've sent to other employers will be deleted.



After that, paste the video link and a few sentences about yourself. No long cover letter. The video is what matters.



I'll pick 5 people from the videos, do a quick call with each, and hire 1. If you take ownership and hate loose ends, I want to talk to you.

title: Video Editor & Content Publisher — Social Media (Part-Time / Full-Time)
description:
I run a used car buying and selling business in Australia and I'm growing my

social media presence across TikTok, Instagram and YouTube. I need an editor

to take my raw footage and turn it into short, medium and long form content.



This is ongoing work, not a one-off project. I'm looking for someone I can

work with long term, who learns my style and gets faster over time.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

- Silence cuts and filler word removal

- Frame changes and cuts to hold attention and improve retention

- Caption overlay

- Music overlay

- Screenshot and image inserts

- B-roll placement

- Managing social media posting

- Thumbnail creation and management



This is NOT heavy motion graphics work. No After Effects wizardry required.

What I need is an eye and an ear for pacing — knowing what holds a Western

audience's attention and what makes them scroll away.



THE STYLE I'M AFTER

Study these accounts before applying:

- Vookum

- Moving Merch

- MosesTheJeweler

- AutoLuxe

- Jerry Sells

- The Saliba Show

- George J Saliba



My current content is 
 on Instagram and TikTok. My delivery

is deadpan and dry — flat, understated, no hype. Important: the pauses are

often the joke. Do not cut every silence. I need someone who can tell the

difference between dead air and comic timing.



WHAT I NEED FROM YOU

- Proven short form editing experience (Reels, TikTok, Shorts)

- Strong English comprehension — you need to understand Australian speech

and humour to cut it properly

- Reliable computer and internet capable of handling large video files

- Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, or equivalent

- Consistent turnaround. Reliability matters more to me than flair.



PAY & PROGRESSION

Starting at 10 hours per week — US$420/month, paid fortnightly via Wise

unless agreed otherwise.



This role is designed to grow. My intention is to move the right person to

full time within 3 months, at US$1,400–1,600/month. I'm not looking for a

freelancer to fill a gap. I'm looking for the person who runs my content

production long term.



Test edit before any commitment.



HOW TO APPLY

Send me:

1. Links to short form videos you have edited (your own cuts only)

2. Your monthly rate for 10 hours per week

3. Answer this question: pick ONE of the accounts listed above and tell me

in 2-3 sentences what that editor does that actually holds attention.

Be specific.



Start your reply with the word "SPEEDOMETER" so I know you read the whole ad.



All applicants must state the amount of years experience they have and the engagement of their top performing reels and shorts.



Applications without the code word or without the answer to question 3 will

not be reviewed.

title: Virtual Home Health Quality Assurance Coordinator
description:
Schedule: Monday - Friday, 3:00 PM - 12:00 AM PST (Tuesday–Saturday, 7:00 AM–4:00 PM Philippine Time), with a 1 hour break

Employment: Full-Time, Long-Term Remote Position



A new and growing United States-based, Medicare-certified home health agency, operational for less than one year, is seeking an experienced, organized, and detail-oriented Virtual Home Health Quality Assurance Coordinator.



A clinical background is required for this position.



The ideal candidate will have experience reviewing clinical documentation for a United States-based home health agency and be familiar with the Medicare Conditions of Participation, home health regulatory requirements, and CHAP accreditation standards.



The selected candidate will support the agency’s Quality Assurance and compliance program by reviewing clinical records, identifying documentation deficiencies, monitoring required corrections, and helping ensure that patient records meet Medicare, regulatory, accreditation, and agency standards.



We are seeking a dependable professional who can communicate respectfully with clinicians, manage multiple priorities, and support the agency's commitment to quality patient care, regulatory compliance, and survey readiness.



Required Qualifications

•	Clinical background required.

•	Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

•	Excellent attention to detail, organization, follow-up, and time management.

•	Ability to identify inconsistencies in assessments, physician orders, plans of care, and clinical documentation.

•	Ability to address documentation concerns professionally and respectfully.

•	Strong multitasking skills and ability to manage competing priorities.

•	Proficiency with EMRs,
, spreadsheets, virtual meeting platforms, and document management systems.

•	Ability to work independently while remaining accountable to leadership.

•	Reliable computer, secure high-speed internet, quiet workspace, backup internet, and backup power source.

•	Full-time availability during California Pacific Time business hours.



Preferred Experience

•	Experience with a U.S.-based Medicare-certified home health agency.

•	Knowledge of Medicare Conditions of Participation and home health regulations.

•	Experience with CHAP accreditation standards and survey preparation.

•	Background in Quality Assurance, clinical documentation review, compliance, utilization review, case management, or chart auditing.

•	Familiarity with OASIS, physician orders, plans of care, face-to-face documentation, homebound status, and skilled-need requirements.

•	Experience reviewing nursing, therapy, and interdisciplinary clinical documentation.

•	Experience with pre-billing chart reviews and documentation correction tracking.

•	Knowledge of survey readiness, audit preparation, and performance improvement.

•	Experience with ADRs, Medicare audits, Synergy, and Joint Commission documentation.



Primary Responsibilities

•	Review home health records for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and timely submission.

•	Review OASIS assessments, physician orders, plans of care, face-to-face documentation, medication profiles, assessments, and visit notes.

•	Validate documentation supporting skilled need, homebound status, diagnoses, ordered services, and the plan of care.

•	Identify missing, incomplete, conflicting, vague, late, or noncompliant documentation.

•	Ensure compliance with Medicare regulations, agency policies, and accreditation standards.

•	Communicate documentation corrections clearly and professionally.

•	Track outstanding corrections and follow through to completion.

•	Verify corrected documents are properly completed, dated, and signed.

•	Assist with pre-billing reviews, chart audits, compliance monitoring, quality reporting, and performance improvement activities.

•	Maintain QA logs, audit tools, correction trackers, and pending-documentation reports.

•	Support preparation for CHAP surveys, Medicare reviews, and regulatory audits.

•	Identify recurring documentation issues and recommend educational opportunities for clinicians.

•	Maintain HIPAA compliance and patient confidentiality.

•	Participate in virtual meetings, training, quality initiatives, and workflow improvement efforts.



Applicants with strong clinical and home health backgrounds may be considered if they demonstrate the ability and willingness to learn Medicare and CHAP requirements.



Preferred Candidate

The ideal candidate will be:

•	Experienced in U.S. home health Quality Assurance.

•	Knowledgeable about Medicare home health documentation and compliance requirements.

•	Familiar with OASIS, plans of care, physician orders, and clinical documentation.

•	Experienced with ADRs, Medicare audits, Synergy, and Joint Commission documentation.

•	Able to provide clear, accurate, and respectful feedback.

•	Organized, dependable, and deadline-oriented.

•	Proactive in identifying and resolving documentation risks.

•	Comfortable communicating with clinicians, physicians, office staff, and leadership.

•	Interested in helping a growing agency build strong Quality Assurance processes.



Compensation and Benefits

•	Starting compensation: $10.00 USD per hour.

•	Three paid holidays annually, subject to approval and staffing coverage.

•	December bonus equivalent to one month of base compensation, subject to performance and company policy.

•	Paid vacation eligibility after one year of service.

•	Compensation review after one year based on performance, attendance, reliability, expanded responsibilities, and company financial performance.

•	Training and professional growth opportunities as the agency expands.



How to Apply

Please submit the following to 

•	Current résumé.

•	Brief summary of clinical background.

•	Summary of U.S. home health experience.

•	Experience with Quality Assurance, chart review, OASIS, clinical documentation, or regulatory compliance.

•	Experience with Medicare Conditions of Participation and/or accreditation standards.

•	List of home health EMR systems used.

•	Confirmation of availability during California Pacific Time business hours.

•	Information regarding computer, internet connection, backup internet, and backup power source.

•	Brief explanation of why you are a strong candidate for this position.



Qualified applicants may be invited to participate in a virtual interview and complete a brief Quality Assurance or clinical documentation assessment.



We are committed to building a professional, collaborative, and supportive team that values clinical accuracy, accountability, compliance, respectful communication, teamwork, and excellent patient care.



Compensation, benefits, work schedule, employment classification, bonus eligibility, and other terms will be confirmed in the final written agreement and administered in accordance with company policy and applicable requirements.

title: One-off website migration project
description:
**Project:** One-off website migration project  

**Positions available:** 2  

**Location:** Remote, with availability during Australian business hours  

**Start:** This week  



### About the project



We are looking for **two highly experienced WordPress migration specialists** to work alongside our existing web design and development team.



We have multiple websites that need to be migrated from **WP Engine and Cloudways to Hostinger**. We need specialists who can get started quickly, manage their assigned websites independently and resolve migration issues without constant supervision.



You must have substantial practical experience migrating live business websites and be able to work efficiently while protecting website functionality, customer enquiries and sales.



### What you’ll be responsible for



- **Review each website before moving it:** Check the current hosting setup, website size, plugins and any special requirements.

- **Back up each website:** Create and verify complete website and database backups, with a clear recovery process if something goes wrong.

- **Complete the migrations:** Move website files, databases and settings to Hostinger, resolving any hosting or compatibility issues.

- **Test before switching over:** Check the migrated website on the new hosting before coordinating the live change with our team.

- **Manage the hosting switch:** Handle DNS, SSL, caching and related settings carefully, keeping downtime to a minimum and protecting existing business
 services.

- **Check the finished website:** Test desktop and mobile layouts, navigation, images, forms and enquiry delivery. For WooCommerce websites, check checkout, payments and customer accounts.

- **Protect existing website activity:** Ensure recent orders, enquiries and content updates are accounted for during the migration.

- **Preserve SEO and tracking:** Check existing URLs, redirects, SEO settings, analytics and conversion tracking after the move.

- **Provide clear updates and handover:** Keep our team informed about completed websites, work in progress and any issues requiring attention.



### Experience and skills required



- Proven experience personally completing multiple WordPress website migrations.

- Strong hands-on knowledge of **WP Engine, Cloudways and Hostinger**.

- Confidence with both manual migrations and migration tools.

- Strong troubleshooting skills across WordPress, databases, DNS, SSL, PHP compatibility, plugins and caching.

- Experience with **WooCommerce, Elementor and WPBakery**.

- Ability to work quickly, prioritise tasks and take ownership of a website through to final testing and handover.

- Clear communication and the ability to coordinate with an existing development team.

- Availability to **start this week**, with working hours that overlap with our Sydney team.



### What a completed migration looks like



A website is complete once it is running correctly on Hostinger, its key functions have been tested, and the results have been handed over to our team. Any outstanding issues must be clearly documented.



### How to apply



Please include:



1. **Your earliest start date** and available hours this week.

2. **Your hourly rate and currency**, or your preferred project pricing arrangement.

3. **Two or three examples of migrations you personally completed**, including the hosting platforms involved.

4. **Your experience with WP Engine, Cloudways and Hostinger**, plus WooCommerce and page builders.

5. **A brief explanation of your migration and testing process**, including how you protect live orders and enquiries.

6. **An example of a difficult migration issue you resolved** and how you fixed it.



**We are hiring two experienced specialists for this one-off project and are ready to get started this week.**

title: Web and UX Specialist
description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION

Students Explore Australia Pty Ltd is on a mission to connect young people with nature, to improve the wellbeing of the next generations. We predominantly achieve this through delivering our main service:

Camps for young people who have significant and permanent disabilities (NDIS Camps)



We have been in operation for 10 years and have a reputation for being a leader in engaging outdoor programs. Students Explore Australia falls between the tourism and education industries.



Our core values are:

1. We resonate good vibes

2. We are hungry to contribute the company’s purpose

3. We are highly organised and disciplined

4. We are adaptable to change

5. We are optimists, with can-do attitudes

6. We see challenge as an opportunity for personal growth





ROLE DESCRIPTION

As the Web and UX Specialist, you will be a cornerstone in our company that ensures the seamless operation, conversion optimization, and technical infrastructure of our online presence. Your role encompasses 3 major components:



1. Website design, development and maintenance

Manage and improve the existing website, including responsive page builds, content, forms, plugins, maintenance, backups, site speed, security and troubleshooting. Use reliable no-code/low-code functionality wherever appropriate.

Lead website information architecture, user journey mapping, practical user research, wireframes and conversion-focused redesigns in collaboration with Marketing and operational stakeholders.

Maintain updates to programs and other content as required to fulfill the marketing plan and support Program Delivery.

Ensure the website is functioning at an optimal level at all times.

Suggest enhancements to UX to improve conversions.



2. Booking & Participant Management System Integration

Implement and maintain the booking and participant management system project from discovery to launch: gather operational and participant requirements, evaluate available booking and membership platforms, recommend a suitable solution and coordinate configuration, integration, workflows and automations, testing and maintenance.

Map and improve end-to-end enquiry, booking and customer journeys, including program discovery, eligibility information, registration, data capture, confirmations, reminders and staff handoffs. Prefer reliable native and low-code integrations over bespoke development. Include member onboarding, self-service account tasks and ongoing engagement where the chosen system supports them.



3. UX Designer

Lead the end-to-end UX design process: research user needs, map guardian and participant journeys, identify pain points, develop information architecture, task flows, wireframes and interactive prototypes, and turn approved concepts into practical website improvements.



Design for accessibility and inclusion, considering WCAG principles, plain language, readable layouts, keyboard navigation, form clarity, mobile usability and the needs of participants with disability and their supporters.

Create consistent, intuitive interfaces across website, enquiry, booking and membership journeys. Define clear navigation, calls to action, input fields, form validation, error states, confirmation screens and recovery paths.

Use qualitative feedback and available analytics to identify drop-offs, simplify high-friction tasks, and improve enquiry and booking completion rates; communicate the reasoning behind design decisions to stakeholders.



4. Testing, quality assurance and workflow improvement

Use written acceptance criteria and repeatable QA checklists before every release.

Test mobile and desktop layouts, supported browsers, accessibility, navigation, forms and critical journeys.

Test booking rules, payment outcomes, confirmation messages, analytics events, API data, error handling, speed and security end to end. Verify production after launch and correct defects promptly.

Map customer and internal workflows, identify bottlenecks and remove unnecessary manual tasks without compromising privacy, security or usability.

Manage concurrent website and eCommerce priorities, agree realistic milestones, work quickly and communicate blockers, trade-offs and progress early.









QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE

Essential:

Strong hands-on WordPress and Elementor experience, including site maintenance, plugins, content updates, responsive builds, security, performance and troubleshooting. Comfortable with visual website builders; able to understand basic HTML/CSS when diagnosing issues. Custom PHP or JavaScript development is not required.

Demonstrated ability to assess platforms and translate business needs into no-code/low-code solutions, own delivery from requirements to launch, configure integrations and coordinate specialist help when needed.

Practical experience delivering eCommerce or booking journeys, including payments, capacity or availability considerations, confirmation communications, integration testing and administrative handover.

Strong UX foundations, including information architecture, user research, wireframing, accessibility and conversion-oriented design; excellent attention to detail in QA.

Strong ownership, prioritisation and communication skills; able to deliver high-quality work promptly while balancing concurrent projects in a remote team.



Highly regarded:

Hands-on Showit, Booking & Membership Management  and/or Klaviyo experience. The combination is preferred, but applicants are not required to have used all three if they have strong adjacent platform experience and can learn quickly.

Experience implementing automated customer data flows,
 segmentation, automated lifecycle communications, and privacy-conscious consent management.

Experience with native integrations, no-code automation tools, APIs/webhooks and CRM/data connections sufficient to configure standard workflows and brief another specialist on exceptions.

Experience with disability-accessible digital design, privacy-aware workflows, booking systems and leading small cross-functional digital projects.





Other Requirements:

- Stable internet connection with a minimum standard of 20 mbps download / 5 mbps upload

- Life-long learner with a thirst for knowledge

- Ability to learn new systems quickly

- Knowledge about travel, education or disability support industries is a bonus but not necessary



WHY WORK WITH US:



- Australian Day Shift - 6:30am to 3:00pm PH Time (Subject to DST changes)

- We have an extremely strong culture built upon our core values, that focuses on our staff wellbeing, including company meditation on Monday and Friday, staff recognition and an optional staff professional development plan.

- Fully funded annual retreat (1 week every year) in South East Asia with the whole company (this year we went to Bali for example)

- Base salary (paid twice a month): Php edit the range (depending on qualifications and experience)

- Additional 13th-month Pay

- Additional Monthly Contributions to SSS, PhilHealth and Pag-IBIG

- 20 Annual Leave Credit Days

- Paid public holiday days off (based on South Australian calendar) - this is in addition to leave credits.



HOW TO APPLY:



This opportunity is not for you, if you do not meet the above-mentioned job requirements. However, if you believe you are the Meta Technical Specialist that will contribute positively to our business, then please send us the following things in your application message:



1. A link of your updated resume (either in word or pdf)

2. Cover letter

3. A link to an approximately two-minute video you have created, that tells us

a) what your hobbies are outside of work

b) tell us about your experience in creating and maintaining a website & process creation for a UX design 



You will only be contacted if you have met the above requirements and included your resume, CV and video.

title: Tech & Ads Specialist
description:
About me and my business:

I'm Kyra Lau, a financial consultant in Singapore with 18 years in the industry. I help busy professionals, both women, women and families, plan their retirement and grow their money.



I get new clients one way:
 and Instagram video ads that send people to a landing page to book a call with me. Every ad has to be approved by my company's compliance team before it runs.



A heads up before you read on: I'm not a tech person. I'd rather be on calls with clients than in GoHighLevel or Ads Manager, so the tech side is yours. Stuff comes up most days and I'll be relying on you to sort it. I'll tell you what I need and get back to you fast, but you need to be independent in implementing tech and ads. If you are independent and love tech and ads, you'll be happy here.





The job in one sentence:

You run everything technical in my business, so that I only have to do two things: talk to clients, and approve what you send me.



The result you own: calls booked on my calendar from ads, at a cost I can afford. The landing pages, the CRM and the ad account all run without me touching them.



The one number that matters: cost per booked call. Not cost per lead, not clicks, not reach. If the calls get booked and I don't have to think about the tech, you are winning.



What you will do:

1. Landing pages

- Build and maintain my book a call landing pages in GoHighLevel from the copy I give you

- Test one change at a time: headline, video, form length, booking step. Tell me what moved the opt in rate

- Make sure the booking calendar, confirmations and reminders fire every time

2. GoHighLevel, my CRM

- Own it: pipeline stages, tags, automations, booking calendar, WhatsApp and
 follow up

- Every lead lands in the right stage with the right tag, and I see it on my phone within minutes

- Keep my numbers dashboard connected, so I can read my numbers without asking you

3. Meta ads

- Run the ad account day to day: campaigns, audiences, budgets, creative rotation

- Turn my approved scripts into live ads. Work with the editor on cuts, write the primary text, headlines and descriptions

- Submit ad copy and creative to my compliance team in batches, track what is approved, tweak and resubmit what is not

- Judge every ad on cost per booked call, not cost per lead. Scale what works, kill what doesn't

4. Reporting

- Five line end of day report on WhatsApp: spend, leads, calls booked, cost per booked call, what you changed

- Weekly 2-3 times ,  30 minute review with me. You bring the numbers and one recommendation

5. AI

Use AI tools every day for ad variations, landing page copy drafts, creative briefs and reporting.





Who this is for:

This is for you if you want growth. This job works on outcomes, not hours. You will own a real number for a real business, and you will grow faster here than almost anywhere else.



This is not for you if:

- You don't like numbers, or you are not good at them

- You don't like tech, or you are not good at it

- You don't like figuring out problems on your own

- You don't like challenges in your job

- You need someone technical to lean on. I'm not technical, and I don't want to be. Everything technical comes to you

- You don't want growth

- You are looking for a 9 to 6 job

If that's you, don't apply. You'll hate the job.





What you need to have done before:

- Built funnels, automations and pipelines in GoHighLevel, not just used it

- Run conversion ads on Meta for a book a call or application funnel, and can show the account

- Know your numbers by heart: cost per lead, cost per booked call, show rate, and what you did when they moved

- Use AI tools every day for copy, creative and reporting

- Can explain a technical problem to a non technical person in two sentences, on WhatsApp, without jargon





Good to have:

- Run ads for a financial adviser, insurer or anything that goes through compliance review

- Basic video editing: cutting one talking head shot into 3 or 4 ad variations





What you get:

1. Growth. You get to learn from the best media buyers in the world, the people I have paid multiple five figures to learn from. Their playbooks, their training, their reviews of your work

2. Fully remote, part time. Work from anywhere in the Philippines. I judge results, not hours. You need to be reachable on WhatsApp during Singapore working hours (9am to 6pm SGT), and check the ads on weekends when they are live

3. Pay: a monthly salary of PHP 40k to 50K

4. Tools paid for: ChatGPT or Claude, Canva, and any editing or ad tools you need

5. One client, one funnel. No juggling ten accounts. You go deep on one business and get very good at it

6. A path up. Do this well for 6 months and you lead the tech and ads for my business as it grows, at a higher rate





How to apply

If this sounds like the role for you, I'd love to hear from you.



Apply here:

title: Remote Virtual Office Manager – Construction Company

 and Communication Management

title: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer (Python/Django)
description:

We're a US-based software company building a comprehensive Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) platform that connects accounting, customer relationships, operations, workflows, and other essential business functions into one integrated system. After 18 months of development, we're looking for our first external software engineer to help complete our MVP, improve existing functionality, and prepare the product for launch. You'll work directly with a technical founder who leads the overall product vision and architecture, while taking ownership of meaningful development work. We're looking for someone who doesn't just write code to make something work, but thinks critically about how to build scalable, flexible, and maintainable systems that can evolve as the product grows.



**What You'll Do**



• Full-Stack Development: Build and improve features across our Django backend, PostgreSQL database, and HTML/CSS/JavaScript frontend.

• Scalable System Design: Develop reusable, configurable, and extensible solutions rather than relying on hardcoded logic or short-term workarounds.

• Feature Ownership: Independently take features from requirements through implementation, testing, and completion.

• Architecture & Problem-Solving: Understand how different modules interact, anticipate edge cases, and recommend thoughtful technical solutions.

title: Bookkeeper/Accountant Zoho Books Expert
description:
Experienced Zoho Books Bookkeeper / Accountant

Australian Kids’ Entertainment Business | Remote, Philippines

Initial Accounts Clean-Up + Ongoing Weekly Bookkeeping

US$6–$10 per hour, depending on experience. Higher rates considered for an exceptional match.



We’re good at making children smile. Now we’d love someone who enjoys making the accounts balance.



We’re Balloonaversal Entertainments, a family-run Australian business helping families celebrate with face painting, balloon twisting, magic, pony rides and more since 2001.



Our working days involve plenty of colour, creativity and happy customers. Behind the scenes, we’re looking for an experienced bookkeeper who brings that same care to our accounts, with considerably fewer balloon animals.



We need someone with extensive hands-on experience in Zoho Books to bring our bookkeeping up to date, improve our accounting setup and then manage our books each week.



If you enjoy investigating discrepancies, untangling historical records and leaving a business better organised than you found it, this could be a satisfying project with a long-term home.



The starting point



Let’s be upfront: our bookkeeping is approximately 18 months behind.



We also migrated from Xero to Zoho Books around 18 months ago, so the initial work will include checking the migration, identifying discrepancies and cleaning up historical records.



Zoho Books is synced with Zoho CRM, so you’ll also need to understand how information moves between the systems and recognise issues that may affect invoices, customers, items and reporting.



We’re looking for someone who can assess the situation calmly, explain what needs attention and work through it methodically.



A love of a good reconciliation will come in handy.



Your first project: get everything up to date (more hours per week will be expected for this initial phase).



You will:



Review the current accounts and prepare a practical clean-up plan, including priorities, missing information and estimated hours.

- Check the Xero-to-Zoho migration, including opening balances, outstanding invoices and bills, and possible missing or duplicated transactions.

- Bring the bookkeeping up to date, accurately recording and categorising transactions.

- Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards and relevant payment-clearing accounts, investigating differences and documenting their resolution.

- Review customer and supplier balances, including overdue, duplicated or incorrectly allocated entries.

- Improve the Chart of Accounts so it is clear, useful and suited to our business.

- Review and tidy Product/Service Items, including naming, duplicates, account mapping and applicable tax settings.

- Review the Zoho Books–Zoho CRM workflow, identify problems and recommend improvements.

- Review GST coding, flag uncertainties and prepare clear supporting records for our Australian accountant’s review.

- Document the improved processes so keeping the books current becomes a manageable weekly routine.



We value sensible improvements, clear explanations and accurate records. Significant changes to the setup should be discussed and agreed before implementation.



Then: keep things running smoothly



Once the catch-up work is complete, we’d like you to continue with ongoing weekly bookkeeping, including:



- Recording and categorising transactions.

- Keeping reconciliations current.

- Maintaining accurate customer and supplier accounts.

- Checking invoices, bills, payments, credits and booking deposits.

- Keeping Zoho Books organised and monitoring relevant CRM sync issues.

- Preparing monthly profit and loss, balance sheet and other agreed reports.

- Providing a brief weekly update covering progress, outstanding questions and anything requiring our attention.

- Preparing records and supporting schedules for our Australian accountant, including GST/BAS review and year-end work.



The goal is accurate, useful accounts that help us understand the business and make decisions confidently.



What you’ll bring



- Extensive hands-on Zoho Books experience, with the confidence to work independently.

- Strong bookkeeping, reconciliation and historical clean-up skills, including investigating discrepancies.

- Clear, friendly communication, initiative and reliable follow-through.

- Australian bookkeeping experience, including GST and BAS preparation support, is highly desirable.

- Experience with Xero-to-Zoho migrations and Zoho CRM integration will be highly valued, as will relevant accounting qualifications.



How to apply



Please start your application with **BALANCED BALLOONS** and answer the following questions. A brief video or voice recording is our preferred way to receive your answers, although written responses are welcome.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to discuss their experience and demonstrate their Zoho Books skills using sample or anonymised information.



We’ll look after the parties. You’ll help us make sure the numbers have a happy ending too.



Please start your application with **BALANCED BALLOONS** and include, just briefly via a video or voice recording:



1. Your Zoho Books experience: How long you’ve used it, the tasks you manage and examples of more complex work you’ve completed.

2. A clean-up example: Describe a bookkeeping backlog or migration problem you resolved, your approach and the outcome. Please keep client details confidential.

3. Your Australian experience: Outline your experience with GST, BAS support and working with Australian accountants.

4. Your systems experience: Tell us about any Xero migrations or Zoho Books–Zoho CRM integrations you’ve worked with.

5. Your initial approach: Briefly explain the first three things you would check in accounts that are 18 months behind following a software migration.

6. Your rate and availability: Include your expected hourly rate in US dollars, earliest start date, availability during the clean-up and preferred ongoing weekly hours.

7. Your CV and relevant qualifications.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited for further discussions about the job.



We’ll look after the parties. You’ll help us make sure the numbers have a happy ending too.

title: Part-Time Sales Development Rep (SDR) | Path to Full-Time and $2,000+ Base | Booking Meetings for US Businesses
description:
Most part-time calling jobs are a dead end. This one is a way in.



At Axion, most part-time SDR hires who perform well are offered a full-time seat within their first 2 to 3 weeks, with a written path from there to $2,000+ a month in base pay alone.



This is a phone role. You’ll make a lot of calls every day, and you’ll hear plenty of no’s. What makes it different: most owners you call have already heard from us, we hand you hot leads all month, and you’re never asking anyone to buy anything. You’ll work 4 focused hours a day, Monday to Friday.



What sets Axion apart is how much we invest in you. Coaching starts on day one and never stops, and every step of your pay is written down, so you always know what it takes to hit your income and career goals. You bring the effort. We’ll help you get there.



If you’ve already booked meetings for US businesses, this role was built for you.





ABOUT AXION



Axion is a performance-based pipeline partner for US marketing agencies. We fund and run the outreach and SDR teams that put qualified business owners on our partners' sales calendars, using the same playbooks behind our own agencies.



Our partners pay only when a qualified owner shows up to a meeting with their sales team. No retainers, no setup fees, no long-term contracts. We invest our own capital first and only get paid when our partners do.



We build careers from the inside. Every new sales and leadership seat goes to the people already here first.



Learn more at 
.



THE ROLE



You'll keep one partner's sales calendar full of qualified meetings.



You'll spend your shift on the phone with US business owners: having a real conversation about their business, checking that they're a good fit, and booking the meeting while you're on the call. If anyone misses their meeting, you'll call to rebook them.



Why this role stands out:



- A head start on every call. Most owners you call have already heard from us, and we hand you every lead.



- Hot leads all month. Most of our SDRs earn nearly half of their commissions from the hot leads we give them.



- An easy yes. You're not selling anything. You're offering a free conversation about getting more customers.



- One partner, one clear job. Talk to owners, qualify them, book the meeting. You get very good at it, fast.



- A focused schedule. 4 hours a day, Monday to Friday, weekends off.



- Training that stays with you. A full onboarding, then hands-on coaching with Adam, our VP of Partner Success: role-plays and call reviews that build sales skills you'll carry for the rest of your career.



WHAT A DAY LOOKS LIKE



- Huddle (15 minutes): role-play, objections and the plan for the day.



- Calling: conversations with business owners, booking qualified meetings on our partner's calendar. Hot leads get a call within minutes.



- Rebooks: anyone who missed their meeting gets a call to find a new time.



- Notes: every call logged in our CRM, and a clear note on every meeting you book.



- Recap: your numbers to Adam at the end of every shift.



PAY



- $500 a month base, in USD



- $5 for every qualified meeting you book that shows up



- A bonus every month you hit your monthly goal, plus extra bonuses for standout performance



- Paid twice a month, straight to your Wise or Payoneer account



- At target, about $600 to $700 a month for 4 hours a day



YOUR CAREER AT AXION



Part-time is how you get in the door. Here's where it leads:



1. Full-time Junior SDR: $900+ base + $5 per qualified meeting. Most part-time SDRs who perform well are offered this within their first 2 to 3 weeks.



2. Senior SDR: $1,300 base + $6 per qualified meeting, about $1,500 to $1,700 a month. Most high performers reach Senior within 2 to 3 months.



3. After 9 months of beating your targets, one of our two top roles:



- Principal SDR, for the best sellers: $2,000 base, $10 per qualified meeting up to your goal and $15 for every one above it. About $2,200 to $2,500+ a month, running one of our flagship partner accounts.



- SDR Manager, for future leaders: $1,800 base plus a team bonus, about $2,200 to $2,500+ a month. You recruit, train and lead your own team.



BONUSES AND REWARDS



We're known for rewarding the people who go all in. The longer you're with us and the more effort you put in, the bigger the rewards. Top performers can earn:



- Performance bonuses from $200 to $5,000



- Family health insurance and VIP HMO upgrades



- Gas and grocery stipends of $1,000 to $2,000, paid 6 months upfront



- Professional housekeeping, worth $1,000 to $3,000 a year



- A premium work-from-home setup: MacBook Pro, Herman Miller Aeron chair, ultra-wide 4K monitor and Jabra headset



- 3-day luxury vacations for up to 5 people, fully covered: Bali, Thailand, Vietnam, or an ultra-luxury trip in the Philippines



WHAT WE LOOK FOR IN AN AXION SDR



We can teach you how to sell. We can't teach the things below, so these are what we hire for. Our four core values:



- Competitive Greatness. You're at your best when it matters most, and you enjoy a hard challenge. Hitting your number isn't the goal. Beating it is.



- Radical Accountability. You own your results and your mistakes.



- Coachability. You want feedback, and we hear it on your very next call. You leave your ego at the door.



- Speed. You move with urgency to not only hit your targets, but exceed them.



And:



- A "no" doesn't slow you down. You'd rather make the next dial than think about the last one.



- You sound like a peer to a business owner, not a call center. Confident, relaxed and direct.



- You show up. Every shift, on time, ready to work.



- Details matter to you. Every call gets logged and every booking gets a clear note.



REQUIREMENTS



- Excellent spoken and written English that sounds natural to US business owners



- SDR, outbound calling or appointment setting experience with US businesses (strongly preferred)



- An active LinkedIn account



- Wired headset and a quiet place to work



- Reliable internet, plus a backup plan if your power or internet drops



- A computer that runs Chrome with several tabs open



- Comfortable using a CRM, a calling app on your computer, and Slack



- Available Monday to Friday, 9am to 1pm US Eastern (10pm to 2am Philippine time until mid-March, then 9pm to 1am when US clocks change)



HOW TO APPLY



We listen to every recording before we read anything else. Send all of the following:



1. Subject line: Axion Part-Time SDR | [Your Name]



2. A voice recording of you reading the script below. Upload it to Google Drive or Vocaroo and paste the link. Say it the way you would on a live call.



3. Your LinkedIn profile link



4. Short answers to these questions:



a. Tell us about your SDR or cold calling experience: who you called, what you booked, and your best month, in real numbers.



b. A business owner tells you, "We already have someone doing our marketing." What do you say next?



c. What's your backup if your internet or power goes out during your shift?



d. What's a big goal you're working toward right now, and how would a career at Axion help you get there?



Applications without a recording won't be reviewed.



SCRIPT FOR YOUR RECORDING



"Hi Dave, this is [your name]. We reached out earlier this week about a few ideas for getting more jobs for your business, and I said I'd give you a quick call. Do you have a minute? Great. I'm not calling to sell you anything. I'd like to set you up with a short video call with a team that works with businesses like yours every day. They'll walk you through what's working in your area right now. Would Tuesday at 2 or Wednesday at 10 work better for you?"



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



1. Shortlisted applicants hear from us within 1-2 business days.



2. A 20-minute live interview with a role-play.



3. If it's a fit, you start with 2 full paid days of onboarding and training.



4. Then you're on the phones.



We're hiring this week.

title: Creative Strategist (Meta Ads, DTC Fitness & Athletics)
description:
Creative Strategist (Meta Ads, DTC Fitness & Athletics)



Location: Remote

Type: Full-Time



About Us

ABG Media is an ecommerce growth brokerage that places talent into ecommerce marketing teams for DTC brands. You'll work inside a client's Meta creative team — alongside editors, designers and a media buyer — and report through our founder.



This seat is for one DTC fitness and strength-training gear brand (physical training products). The work is Meta ads: angles, hooks, briefs, and the feedback loop that turns tests into winners.



The role

You own the Meta creative strategy for this brand. That means you do not just write a brief and disappear. You stay in the whole process: research and angles, hooks, production-ready briefs, feedback with editors and designers, reading results with the media buyer, then iterating or killing and briefing the next test.



Volume: 20 briefs a week, consistently. This is a must-pass. If you cannot hold that cadence, do not apply.



You will

- Mine customer language (reviews, Reddit, comments, support, Ad Library) and turn it into angles and hooks for a physical fitness / strength-training product

- Write production-ready briefs for editors and designers (avatar, awareness stage, hook, offer/destination, the one metric that proves it, and what to iterate next)

- Stay engaged after the brief: notes on first cuts, hook variants, what to kill, what to scale

- Read Ads Manager performance with the media buyer and d
 ad vs page vs offer blame correctly

- Ship a steady 20-brief week, every week



You have

- Proven Meta creative-strategy experience on athletics, sports, fitness or strength-training gear, or other physical DTC products — brands, products, and proof, not claims alone

- Ads Manager spend proof for ads you strategized: screenshots or a screen-share with dates and spend. ROAS claims without proof will not be reviewed

- A real weekly output of 20 briefs, and examples that show you stay in the process with editors, designers and a media buyer

- Clear written English

- Required: available and responsive during 8am–5pm CT (US Central) business hours, Monday–Friday. This is about being reachable (Slack/calls), not a fixed shift

- You keep learning the craft, and you can say where you learned it and what you changed because of it



Before you apply — read this:

"Identify problems and solve the problems. If you can't identify a problem, you do not have a job. If you can't solve a problem, you do not keep your job. Problem-solving is the most critical mentality that every team member must have. No exceptions. If you're not a problem solver, please remove yourself and do not apply. The problems will only get harder, so you better get good at dealing with them and learn to expect them."



Process: written questions → short paid test (no account access) → interview → final with the founder.



To apply, answer every item below in your application. Applications that skip the scenario, skip spend proof, or skip the keyword will not be reviewed.



1. Which athletics, sports, fitness, strength-training gear, or other physical DTC brands have you done Meta creative strategy for? Name the products, your role (strategy vs buying vs editing), and one result with numbers. Attach Ads Manager screenshots (dates and spend visible; brand can be blurred) for ads you strategized, or say you can screen-share the same proof on a call.

2. Scenario (must-pass): A Meta product's ROAS dropped 35% over 5 days. Spend is flat, CTR is steady, CVR is down, and nobody changed the ads. What do you think the problem is, how would you confirm it, and what would you ship this week to fix it?

3. How many briefs do you write in a normal week? Walk through how you stay involved after the brief — with editors, designers and the media buyer — through feedback, results and the next test. Confirm you can hold 20 briefs a week in this seat.

4. Availability (must-pass): Will you be available and responsive (Slack/calls) during 8am–5pm CT business hours, Mon–Fri? Give your country, time zone and how quickly you typically reply.

5. Where did you learn creative strategy, and how do you keep learning the craft (courses, programs, mentors, communities, Ad Library teardowns)? If it was Ecom University or Evolve, say so. Name one thing you changed in your work in the last 90 days because of what you learned.

6. Put the words CLEAN LIFTS somewhere in your application so we know you read this.



Generic or AI-template answers without brands, numbers, or spend proof will not be reviewed.

Our business has several different areas:



• We tour pantomimes into primary schools across the UK.

• We deliver secondary school theatre and education workshops across the UK, particularly around GCSE English texts such as Macbeth, Romeo & Juliet, An Inspector Calls and Blood Brothers.

• We run children’s theatre holiday clubs during school holidays.

• We produce a larger commercial pantomime in the Isle of Man.



We have lots happening across all of these areas, but one of our biggest challenges is simply having the time and expertise internally to market everything consistently and properly.



We’re therefore looking for support across areas such as:



• Social media management and content

• Paid social advertising and optimisation

•
 marketing campaigns

• Building structured follow-up and retargeting campaigns

• Marketing our workshops directly to schools

• Campaigns around our school pantomime tours

• Marketing our holiday clubs to parents

• Marketing and paid advertising for our commercial Isle of Man pantomime

• Helping us organise, manage and make better use of our existing marketing assets and creative

• Monitoring campaign performance and continually improving what we’re doing



We currently use Genie AI / LeadConnector** for CRM, leads and follow-up, and **Campus**, which is part of Sprint Media, for some of our
 marketing to schools. Ideally, we’d like somebody who is comfortable getting to grips with these platforms rather than simply producing content for us.



The good news is that we’re not starting from scratch.



Through the work we’ve been doing with Entrepreneurs Circle Masterplan, we’ve already developed customer avatars, value propositions and a much clearer marketing strategy for the different parts of the business. We also have a substantial amount of existing content, imagery, databases and creative.



For example, we already have new creative produced for our Isle of Man pantomime which we need to start putting to work as soon as possible.



What we’re really missing is someone with the time and expertise to take all of this and **make it happen consistently** — setting campaigns up properly, testing them, following up leads, optimising what is working and helping us build a much more joined-up marketing operation.



We’re a small team, so we’re not necessarily looking for a huge agency relationship. We’d much rather find the right person or small team who can get to know our business and work alongside us on either an ongoing, per project basis. 



I think the best next step would probably be a conversation so that I can explain the business in a little more detail, show you what we already have in place and understand how you work and what level of support you could provide.



We're initially looking for someone for approximately 20 hours per week, with flexible working arrangements and the possibility of increasing hours as the role develops. We're looking for someone proactive who can take ownership of campaigns, suggest improvements and become a valued part of our team.



If this sounds like something you could help us with, I’d love to arrange an initial call.



Thanks a million,



Mike  

Stage-ed
